        RAW_JSON.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        RAW_JSON.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        NOTES_JSON.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        NOTES_JSON.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        log(f"report written: {NOTES_JSON}")
        log(f"sameproc_change median wall: {scenarios['sameproc_change']['wall_index_s_median']}s")
        return 0
    except BaseException:
        import traceback

        log("FATAL:\n" + traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        p28.restore_instrumentation()
        log.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
scripts/phase30_index_profile.py:
"""Phase30 T08: index correctness and performance re-check after the re-export fix.

Phase30 makes the Phase29 incremental fast path fall back to a full rebuild
whenever a changed file's resolved IMPORT target set moves (re-export retarget).
This script re-runs the correctness oracles and the small performance set on
that changed code path:

- digest equivalence: incremental re-index after a hub body edit must reproduce
  the fresh full index's semantic digest byte-for-byte (452-file synthetic repo);
- re-export probes: 1-hop and 2-hop re-export retargets must make the
  incremental dump equal a fresh full dump (field-identical, same repo id);
- performance: cold / sameproc_nochange / sameproc_change medians (2 warmups +
  3 measured, in-process timing — the Phase29 run used subprocess isolation, so
  absolute numbers are comparable in trend only) compared against the Phase29
  baseline in docs/notes/phase29-index-profile.json.

Boundary: deterministic synthetic repos only; absolute times must not be
extrapolated to large real repositories. Zero network, zero model, zero Docker.

Usage: ``.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase30_index_profile.py``
Output: ``.codex-pytest-tmp/phase30/index-profile-raw.json`` and
``docs/notes/phase30-index-profile.json``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRATCH = REPO_ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase30"
WORK_DIR = SCRATCH / "work"
WORKSPACE_DIR = WORK_DIR / "workspace"
REEXPORT_DIR = WORK_DIR / "reexport"
RAW_JSON = SCRATCH / "index-profile-raw.json"
NOTES_JSON = REPO_ROOT / "docs" / "notes" / "phase30-index-profile.json"
P29_BASELINE = REPO_ROOT / "docs" / "notes" / "phase29-index-profile.json"


def load_profile_machinery() -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    """Import the Phase29 profile module (which loads Phase28) and repoint its
    scratch paths into .codex-pytest-tmp/phase30 so no prior deliverable moves."""
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "phase29_index_profile", REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "phase29_index_profile.py"
    )
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    p29 = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules.setdefault("phase29_index_profile", p29)
    spec.loader.exec_module(p29)
    p29.SCRATCH = SCRATCH
    p29.WORK_DIR = WORK_DIR
    p29.WORKSPACE_DIR = WORKSPACE_DIR
    p29.CHILD_DIR = SCRATCH / "child"
    p29.RAW_JSON = RAW_JSON
    p29.LOG_PATH = SCRATCH / "index-profile.log"
    p28 = p29.load_p28()
    return p28, p29


def median(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> float:
    values = sorted(run["wall_index_s"] for run in runs)
    return round(values[len(values) // 2], 4)


def aggregate(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"runs": runs, "wall_index_s_median": median(runs)}


def semantic_digest(p29: Any, stores: Any, repository_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return p29.semantic_digest(stores, repository_id)


def digest_full_index(p28: Any, p29: Any, db_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stores = p28.open_db(db_path, fresh=True)
    indexer, _events = p28.make_indexer()
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
    digest = semantic_digest(p29, stores, workspace.repository_id)
    p28.close_db(stores)
    return digest


def digest_incremental_after_hub_edit(
    p28: Any, p29: Any, db_path: Path, variant: int
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Open the existing db, edit the hub body, re-index incrementally, digest."""
    stores = p28.open_db(db_path, fresh=False)
    indexer, _events = p28.make_indexer()
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    (WORKSPACE_DIR / p28.HUB_RELPATH).write_text(
        p28.hub_variant(variant), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    result = p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=True)
    digest = semantic_digest(p29, stores, workspace.repository_id)
    p28.close_db(stores)
    return digest, result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- re-export


REEXPORT_FILES = {
    "pkg/__init__.py": "",
    "pkg/a.py": "def value() -> int:\n    return 1\n",
    "pkg/b.py": "def value() -> int:\n    return 2\n",
    "pkg/hub.py": "from pkg.a import value\n",
    "pkg/mid.py": "from pkg.hub import value\n",
    "pkg/consumer.py": "from pkg.mid import value\n\n\ndef use() -> int:\n    return value()\n",
}
REEXPORT_RETARGET = "from pkg.b import value\n"


def reexport_probe() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """1-hop and 2-hop re-export retargets: incremental dump == fresh full dump."""
    from codepilot.repo.index import Indexer
    from codepilot.repo.parser import TreeSitterParser
    from codepilot.repo.workspace import Workspace, normalize_source
    from codepilot.storage.db import create_engine_from_url, create_session_factory, init_db
    from codepilot.storage.repository import Stores

    def make_stores() -> Any:
        engine = create_engine_from_url("sqlite://")
        init_db(engine)
        return Stores(create_session_factory(engine)())

    def workspace(repository_id: str) -> Any:
        return Workspace(
            path=REEXPORT_DIR,
            source=normalize_source(str(REEXPORT_DIR)),
            base_commit="0" * 40,
            repository_id=repository_id,
        )

    def dump(stores: Any, repository_id: str) -> tuple:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            "p30_indexdump", REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "support" / "indexdump.py"
        )
        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module.dump_index(stores, repository_id)

    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for label, _retarget in (
        ("one_hop", "from pkg.hub import value\n"),
        ("two_hop", REEXPORT_RETARGET),
    ):
        if REEXPORT_DIR.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(REEXPORT_DIR)
        files = dict(REEXPORT_FILES)
        if label == "one_hop":
            # consumer imports hub directly; retarget hub itself
            files["pkg/mid.py"] = ""
        for rel, text in files.items():
            path = REEXPORT_DIR / rel
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        repository_id = f"repo_p30_reexport_{label}"
        stores = make_stores()
        indexer = Indexer(parser=TreeSitterParser())
        indexer.index(stores, workspace(repository_id))
        stores.session.commit()
        # Retarget the hub (1-hop: consumer sees hub change; 2-hop: mid+consumer).
        (REEXPORT_DIR / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text(
            REEXPORT_RETARGET, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
        )
        stats = indexer.index(stores, workspace(repository_id))
        stores.session.commit()
        incremental = dump(stores, repository_id)[1:]
        ref = make_stores()
        Indexer(parser=TreeSitterParser()).index(ref, workspace(repository_id))
        ref.session.commit()
        full = dump(ref, repository_id)[1:]
        results[label] = {
            "association_mode": stats.association_mode,
            "incremental_equals_full": incremental == full,
        }
        if incremental != full:
            for index, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(incremental, full, strict=False)):
                if left != right:
                    results[label]["first_diff"] = {
                        "index": index,
                        "incremental": repr(left),
                        "full": repr(right),
                    }
                    break
            results[label]["lens"] = {"incremental": len(incremental), "full": len(full)}
    return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--skip-workspace", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.parse_args(argv)
    p28, p29 = load_profile_machinery()
    WORK_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("phase30 index profile start", flush=True)

    p28.generate_workspace(WORKSPACE_DIR)
    db_path = WORK_DIR / "phase30-main.sqlite"

    # 1. cold
    cold_runs = []
    for _ in range(3):
        stores = p28.open_db(db_path, fresh=True)
        indexer, _events = p28.make_indexer()
        workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
        result = p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
        cold_runs.append(
            {"wall_index_s": result["wall_index_s"], "mode": result["association_mode"]}
        )
        p28.close_db(stores)
    cold = aggregate(cold_runs)
    print(f"cold median {cold['wall_index_s_median']}s", flush=True)

    # 2. sameproc_nochange (2 warmups + 3 measured)
    stores = p28.open_db(db_path, fresh=True)
    indexer, _events = p28.make_indexer()
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
    for _ in range(p28.WARMUPS):
        p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
    nochange_runs = []
    for _ in range(p28.MEASURED):
        result = p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
        nochange_runs.append(
            {"wall_index_s": result["wall_index_s"], "mode": result["association_mode"]}
        )
    p28.close_db(stores)
    nochange = aggregate(nochange_runs)
    print(f"sameproc_nochange median {nochange['wall_index_s_median']}s", flush=True)

    # 3. sameproc_change (2 warmups + 3 measured, hub body edit per run)
    stores = p28.open_db(db_path, fresh=True)
    indexer, _events = p28.make_indexer()
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
    change_runs = []
    for run_index in range(p28.WARMUPS + p28.MEASURED):
        (WORKSPACE_DIR / p28.HUB_RELPATH).write_text(
            p28.hub_variant(run_index), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
        )
        result = p28.execute_index(indexer, stores, workspace, db_path, record=False)
        entry = {"wall_index_s": result["wall_index_s"], "mode": result["association_mode"]}
        if run_index >= p28.WARMUPS:
            change_runs.append(entry)
        else:
            print(
                f"  warmup {run_index}: {entry['wall_index_s']}s mode={entry['mode']}", flush=True
            )
    p28.close_db(stores)
    change = aggregate(change_runs)
    print(f"sameproc_change median {change['wall_index_s_median']}s", flush=True)

    # 4. Digest equivalence after the last hub edit (incremental vs fresh full).
    digest_incremental, last_result = digest_incremental_after_hub_edit(
        p28, p29, db_path, variant=p28.WARMUPS + p28.MEASURED
    )
    digest_full_after = digest_full_index(p28, p29, WORK_DIR / "phase30-ref.sqlite")
    digest_baseline = digest_full_index(p28, p29, WORK_DIR / "phase30-base.sqlite")

    # 5. Re-export retarget probes (1-hop / 2-hop).
    reexport = reexport_probe()

    baseline = json.loads(P29_BASELINE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    p29_scenarios = baseline["scenarios"]

    def compare(name: str, current: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        previous = p29_scenarios[name]["wall_index_s_median"]
        return {
            "phase30_median_s": current["wall_index_s_median"],
            "phase29_baseline_s": previous,
            "delta_s": round(current["wall_index_s_median"] - previous, 4),
            "delta_percent": round((current["wall_index_s_median"] - previous) / previous * 100, 1)
            if previous
            else None,
        }

    report = {
        "tool": "phase30_index_profile",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "method": {
            "reuse": "phase29_index_profile/phase28_index_profile machinery (imported; scratch repointed to .codex-pytest-tmp/phase30; no prior deliverable written)",
            "timing": "in-process wall time (Phase29 used subprocess isolation; compare trends, not absolute values)",
            "warmups": p28.WARMUPS,
            "measured": p28.MEASURED,
            "aggregation": "median of measured runs",
            "boundary": "deterministic synthetic repos only; absolute times must not be extrapolated",
        },
        "environment": p28.probe_environment(),
        "scenarios": {
            "cold": cold,
            "sameproc_nochange": nochange,
            "sameproc_change": change,
        },
        "comparison_to_phase29": {
            "cold": compare("cold", cold),
            "sameproc_nochange": compare("sameproc_nochange", nochange),
            "sameproc_change": compare("sameproc_change", change),
        },
        "semantic_digests": {
            "baseline_full_index": digest_baseline,
            "incremental_after_hub_edit": digest_incremental,
            "fresh_full_after_edit": digest_full_after,
            "incremental_equals_fresh_full": digest_incremental["sha256"]
            == digest_full_after["sha256"],
            "last_incremental_mode": last_result["association_mode"],
        },
        "reexport_retarget_probes": reexport,
    }
    RAW_JSON.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    RAW_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    NOTES_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                k: report[k]
                for k in ("comparison_to_phase29", "semantic_digests", "reexport_retarget_probes")
            },
            indent=2,
        )
    )
    ok = report["semantic_digests"]["incremental_equals_fresh_full"] and all(
        v["incremental_equals_full"] for v in reexport.values()
    )
    print(f"phase30 index profile done ok={ok}")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
scripts/phase31_receipt.py:
"""Deterministic schema-5 receipt generation for any candidate in the chain.

The parent is read from the candidate record itself; an explicit parent argument is
only an assertion that must agree with candidate.json. The record status must be
pending and is copied into the receipt, and both schema_version and
candidate_schema_version must be 5. The external witness is never stored here.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from codepilot.archive import ArchiveError, _git, _resolved_commit, candidate_tree_sha256

RECEIPT_FILE_NAMES = ("candidate.diff", "candidate.json", "snapshot.json", "sources.json")

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def generate_receipt(
    *,
    repo: Path,
    candidate: str,
    archive_root: Path,
    receipt: Path,
    candidate_commit: str,
    source_commit: str,
    diff_base: str,
    manifest_commit: str,
    parent: str | None = None,
    replace: bool = False,
    reason: str = "",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate committed input identities before writing a deterministic receipt."""
    if receipt.exists() and (not replace or not reason.strip()):
        raise ArchiveError("receipt exists; --replace and a nonempty --reason are required")
    if replace and not reason.strip():
        raise ArchiveError("--replace requires --reason")
    candidate_commit = _resolved_commit(repo, "candidate_commit", candidate_commit)
    source_commit = _resolved_commit(repo, "source_commit", source_commit)
    diff_base = _resolved_commit(repo, "diff_base", diff_base)
    manifest_commit = _resolved_commit(repo, "manifest_commit", manifest_commit)
    candidates = archive_root.resolve()
    prefix = candidates.relative_to(repo.resolve()).as_posix()
    folder = candidates / candidate
    record = json.loads((folder / "candidate.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected = {
        "schema_version": 5,
        "candidate_schema_version": 5,
        "version": candidate,
        "source_commit": source_commit,
        "diff_base_commit": diff_base,
    }
    for field, value in expected.items():
        if record.get(field) != value:
            raise ArchiveError(f"candidate.json {field} differs from required input {value!r}")
    record_parent = record.get("parent")
    if not isinstance(record_parent, str) or not record_parent.strip():
        raise ArchiveError("candidate.json parent must be a nonempty string")
    if parent is not None and parent != record_parent:
        raise ArchiveError(
            f"candidate.json parent {record_parent!r} differs from requested parent {parent!r}"
        )
    record_status = record.get("status")
    if record_status != "pending":
        raise ArchiveError(f"candidate.json status must be pending, got {record_status!r}")
    if not (candidates / record_parent).is_dir():
        raise ArchiveError("parent directory missing")
    for name in ("active.json", "active.next.json"):
        if (candidates.parent / name).exists():
            raise ArchiveError("active pointer must be absent")
    for ancestor, descendant in (
        (source_commit, candidate_commit),
        (diff_base, source_commit),
        (candidate_commit, "HEAD"),
        (manifest_commit, "HEAD"),
    ):
        _git(repo, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
    hashes = {}
    for name in RECEIPT_FILE_NAMES:
        raw = (folder / name).read_bytes()
        if raw != _git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{candidate_commit}:{prefix}/{candidate}/{name}"):
            raise ArchiveError(f"{name} disk bytes differ from candidate_commit blob")
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    manifest = _git(
        repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{manifest_commit}:{prefix}/historical-baseline.json"
    )
    if manifest != (candidates / "historical-baseline.json").read_bytes():
        raise ArchiveError("current manifest differs from manifest_commit blob")
    payload = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "candidate": candidate,
        "candidate_commit": candidate_commit,
        "source_commit": source_commit,
        "diff_base": diff_base,
        "status": record_status,
        "candidate_files": hashes,
        "candidate_tree_sha256": candidate_tree_sha256(hashes),
        "manifest_commit": manifest_commit,
        "manifest_blob_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest(),
        "historical_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest(),
        "created_at": _git(repo, "show", "-s", "--format=%cI", manifest_commit).decode().strip(),
    }
    if replace:
        payload["replacement_reason"] = reason.strip()
        payload["replaced_receipt_sha256"] = (
            hashlib.sha256(receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if receipt.exists() else None
        )
    receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    )
    return payload


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--archive-root", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT / "configs/harness/candidates"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)
    for name in ("candidate-commit", "source-commit", "diff-base", "manifest-commit"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{name}", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--parent", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--replace", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--reason", default="")
    args = vars(parser.parse_args(argv))
    try:
        generate_receipt(repo=REPO_ROOT, **args)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"error": str(exc)}))
        return 1
    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(args["receipt"]), "generated": True}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
scripts/phase32_activation_dryrun.py:
"""Phase32 W4: v5 activation dry-run against a throwaway archive root.

Why not the real pointer: ``configs/harness/active.json`` must stay absent (v5
is pending, no activation this phase). The functions under test take an
explicit archive root, and ``rsi.select`` stages ``active.next.json`` and then
renames it, so running them against a copied root exercises the exact staging
path while leaving the repository pointer untouched.

What this proves, in order:
 1. with no pointer the fail-closed path yields the builtin pending selection;
 2. a pending candidate is refused by ``select`` unless ``allow_pending`` is set;
 3. staging the v5 snapshot writes ``active.next.json`` then ``active.json``
    inside the temp root and ``load_selection`` reads the v5 snapshot back;
 4. the real archive root still has no pointer and the v4/v5 candidate records
    are byte-identical before and after.

Usage: ``.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_activation_dryrun.py``
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

from codepilot import rsi  # noqa: E402

SCRATCH = ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase32"
REAL_ARCHIVE = ROOT / "configs" / "harness"
VERSION = "phase31-candidate-v5"
PARENT = "phase30-candidate-v4"
OUT = SCRATCH / "activation-dryrun.json"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pointer_names(archive: Path) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(name for name in ("active.json", "active.next.json") if (archive / name).exists())


def candidate_digest(archive: Path, version: str) -> str:
    return sha256(archive / "candidates" / version / "candidate.json")


def main() -> int:
    SCRATCH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp_archive = SCRATCH / "activation-dryrun" / "archive"
    if temp_archive.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(temp_archive)
    # Copy the whole archive root: snapshot validation can reach sibling
    # evidence (comparisons/), and the copy must contain no pointer to start
    # from the same fail-closed state as the repository.
    shutil.copytree(REAL_ARCHIVE, temp_archive)
    assert pointer_names(temp_archive) == [], "fixture archive must start pointer-free"
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "version": VERSION,
        "parent": PARENT,
        "real_archive": str(REAL_ARCHIVE.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "temp_archive": str(temp_archive.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "real_pointers_before": pointer_names(REAL_ARCHIVE),
        "v5_candidate_sha256_before": candidate_digest(REAL_ARCHIVE, VERSION),
        "v4_candidate_sha256_before": candidate_digest(REAL_ARCHIVE, PARENT),
    }

    builtin = rsi.load_selection(temp_archive)
    record["no_pointer_selection"] = {
        "version": builtin.get("version"),
        "status": builtin.get("status"),
    }

    refused = None
    try:
        rsi.select(temp_archive, VERSION)
    except ValueError as exc:
        refused = str(exc)
    record["pending_without_allow_pending"] = {"refused": refused is not None, "error": refused}
    record["temp_pointers_after_refusal"] = pointer_names(temp_archive)

    rsi.select(temp_archive, VERSION, allow_pending=True)
    record["temp_pointers_after_select"] = pointer_names(temp_archive)
    record["temp_active"] = json.loads((temp_archive / "active.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    selection = rsi.load_selection(temp_archive)
    record["loaded_selection"] = {
        "version": selection.get("version"),
        "status": selection.get("status"),
        "parent": selection.get("parent"),
        "prompt_roles": sorted(selection.get("prompts", {})),
        "experience_count": len(selection.get("experiences", [])),
    }

    record["real_pointers_after"] = pointer_names(REAL_ARCHIVE)
    record["v5_candidate_sha256_after"] = candidate_digest(REAL_ARCHIVE, VERSION)
    record["v4_candidate_sha256_after"] = candidate_digest(REAL_ARCHIVE, PARENT)
    record["real_pointer_absent"] = record["real_pointers_after"] == []
    record["candidates_untouched"] = (
        record["v5_candidate_sha256_before"] == record["v5_candidate_sha256_after"]
        and record["v4_candidate_sha256_before"] == record["v4_candidate_sha256_after"]
    )
    record["pending_refused_without_flag"] = refused is not None
    record["ok"] = bool(
        record["real_pointer_absent"]
        and record["candidates_untouched"]
        and record["pending_refused_without_flag"]
        and record["loaded_selection"]["version"] == VERSION
        and record["loaded_selection"]["status"] == "pending"
        # select stages active.next.json and renames it onto active.json, so the
        # only pointer left is the target itself.
        and record["temp_pointers_after_select"] == ["active.json"]
    )
    OUT.write_text(
        json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    print(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0 if record["ok"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
scripts/phase32_index_profile.py:
"""Phase32 T09 / Phase33 T05: index performance on a real repository.

Scenarios (each an isolated child process, its own SQLite database file):

1. "cold"        - fresh database, first full index of the copied tree;
2. "nochange"    - copy of the cold database, same bytes: verified-snapshot reuse;
3. "change"      - one new function is added to a real module (symbol set changes);
4. "change_body" - the same module gets a body-only edit (symbols identical).

Phase33 T05 changes over the Phase32 version:

* never writes into .codex-pytest-tmp/phase32/ (historical evidence, read-only);
  every artifact is redirected through --scratch / --dbroot / --out /
  --checkpoint-dir;
* each scenario gets its own database directory "<dbroot>-<scenario>/index.sqlite3",
  chained by copying the previous scenario's database files (no shared mutable DB);
* tolerant instrumentation: phase timing labels are installed per-target with
  hasattr guards, so the script works both before and after the index.py refactor
  (Phase32's runs had empty phases because run_one never installed them);
* the commit under test is pinned (git archive <sha>) and the export can be
  reused (--reuse-export) so baseline and after runs index identical bytes;
* built-in verification: after the chain, fresh full indexes of the probe-42 and
  probe-43 states are dump-compared (tests/support/indexdump.dump_index, pickled
  bytes -> sha256) against the incremental change / change_body databases, plus
  nochange vs cold;
* --checkpoint-dir progress files "index-profile[-tag]-<scenario>.done" so an
  interrupted drive can be resumed/audited (OOM-history machine).

Usage:

    # full baseline drive (tag=baseline)
    .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_index_profile.py \
        --scratch .codex-pytest-tmp/phase33/evidence/t05/scratch \
        --dbroot .codex-pytest-tmp/phase33/evidence/t05/db \
        --out .codex-pytest-tmp/phase33/evidence/t05/profile-baseline.json

    # single scenario (child), compatible with the Phase32 CLI
    .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_index_profile.py \
        --run cold --db <db> --root <export> --source-commit <sha>

    # byte-compare two index databases of the same workspace state
    .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_index_profile.py \
        --compare <dbA> <dbB> --root <export> --source-commit <sha>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_SCRATCH = REPO_ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase33" / "evidence" / "t05" / "scratch"
DEFAULT_DBROOT = REPO_ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase33" / "evidence" / "t05" / "db"
DEFAULT_OUT = REPO_ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase33" / "evidence" / "t05" / "profile.json"
DEFAULT_CHECKPOINTS = REPO_ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase33" / "runs"
PROBE = "\n\ndef _phase32_probe() -> int:\n    return 42\n"
PROBE_BODY = PROBE.replace("return 42", "return 43")


def load_p28() -> Any:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "phase28_index_profile", REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "phase28_index_profile.py"
    )
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules.setdefault("phase28_index_profile", module)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- instrumentation


def install_instrumentation_tolerant(p28: Any) -> list[str]:
    """Install p28 phase timers, skipping targets that no longer exist.

    The Phase33 closure refactor may rename or add module-level helpers in
    codepilot.repo.index; every label is optional so one script works against
    both the old and the new implementation. Returns the missing labels.
    """
    import codepilot.repo.index as index_module
    from codepilot.storage.repository import EdgeStore, FileStore, SymbolStore

    missing: list[str] = []
    targets: list[tuple[Any, str, str]] = [
        (p28.RepositoryScanner, "scan", "scan"),
        (p28.TreeSitterParser, "parse", "parse"),
        (p28.AnalysisContext, "__init__", "context_build"),
        (p28.ImportResolver, "__init__", "imports_resolve"),
        (index_module, "_extract_all_edges", "extract_all_edges"),
        (index_module, "_affected_closure", "affected_closure"),
        (index_module, "_closure_source_maps", "closure_source_maps"),
        (index_module, "extract_calls", "extract_calls"),
        (index_module, "extract_edges", "extract_edges"),
        (index_module, "extract_test_links", "extract_test_links"),
        (index_module, "_edge_rows", "edge_rows_build"),
        (index_module, "_resolve_dangling", "resolve_dangling"),
        (index_module, "_replace_test_edges", "replace_test_edges"),
        (index_module, "_import_bindings_changed", "import_bindings_guard"),
        (SymbolStore, "replace_for_files", "symbols.replace_for_files"),
        (SymbolStore, "list_by_repo", "symbols.list_by_repo"),
        (SymbolStore, "count_by_kind", "symbols.count_by_kind"),
        (FileStore, "upsert_many", "files.upsert_many"),
        (FileStore, "list_by_repo", "files.list_by_repo"),
        (EdgeStore, "delete_by_kind", "edges.delete_by_kind"),
        (EdgeStore, "delete_by_ids", "edges.delete_by_ids"),
        (EdgeStore, "list_dangling_targets", "edges.list_dangling_targets"),
        (EdgeStore, "count_by_kind_confidence", "edges.count_by_kind_confidence"),
    ]
    for owner, attr, label in targets:
        if hasattr(owner, attr):
            p28._install_patch(owner, attr, label)
        else:
            missing.append(f"{getattr(owner, '__name__', owner)}.{attr}")

    # Same timed copy p28 uses: splits replace_for_sources into delete/insert/flush.
    from itertools import batched

    from sqlalchemy import delete, insert

    from codepilot.storage.models import GraphEdge

    timer = p28._TIMER

    def timed_replace_for_sources(
        self: Any, repo_id: str, source_ids: list[str], rows: Any
    ) -> None:
        if source_ids:
            with timer.phase("edges.replace_for_sources.delete"):
                self._s.execute(
                    delete(GraphEdge).where(
                        GraphEdge.repository_id == repo_id,
                        GraphEdge.source_id.in_(list(source_ids)),
                    )
                )
        with timer.phase("edges.replace_for_sources.insert"):
            for edge_batch in batched(rows, 1000):
                self._s.execute(insert(GraphEdge), list(edge_batch))
        with timer.phase("edges.replace_for_sources.flush"):
            self._s.flush()

    attr = "replace_for_sources"
    p28._PATCHES.append((EdgeStore, attr, getattr(EdgeStore, attr)))
    # dynamic setattr: instrumented method replacement, same mechanism as _install_patch
    # (a literal assignment would trip mypy method-assign; a constant setattr trips ruff B010).
    setattr(EdgeStore, attr, timer.wrap("edges.replace_for_sources", timed_replace_for_sources))
    return missing


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- export / child


def pinned_head(repo: Path, pin: str) -> str:
    if pin:
        return pin
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()


def export_tracked(repo: Path, dest: Path, commit: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Copy the tracked files of repo at commit into dest."""
    if dest.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(dest)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True)
    archive = dest.parent / "realrepo.tar"
    with archive.open("wb") as handle:
        subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo), "archive", "--format=tar", commit],
            stdout=handle,
            check=True,
        )
    with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
        tar.extractall(dest, filter="data")
    archive.unlink()
    (dest / ".export-head").write_text(commit + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    files = sum(1 for path in dest.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
    return {"source_repo": str(repo), "source_head": commit, "exported_files": files}


def run_one(
    scenario: str,
    db: Path,
    root: Path,
    source_commit: str,
    *,
    fresh: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Index root once in this process and report the observable counts."""
    p28 = load_p28()
    p28.WORKSPACE_DIR = root
    p28.BASE_COMMIT = source_commit
    missing = install_instrumentation_tolerant(p28)
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    indexer, events = p28.make_indexer()
    if fresh or scenario == "cold":
        p28.delete_db_files(db)
    db.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stores = p28.open_db(db, fresh=False)
    try:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        result: dict[str, Any] = p28.execute_index(
            indexer, stores, workspace, db, record=True, events=events
        )
        wall = time.perf_counter() - started
    finally:
        p28.close_db(stores)
        p28.restore_instrumentation()
    result.update(
        {
            "scenario": scenario,
            "db_path": str(db),
            "workspace": str(root),
            "child_total_wall_s": round(wall, 4),
            "base_commit": source_commit,
            "instrumentation_missing": missing,
        }
    )
    return result


def pick_probe_file(root: Path) -> Path:
    """Largest Python module outside tests: the edit changes a real body."""
    candidates = [
        path
        for path in root.rglob("*.py")
        if "tests" not in path.parts and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
    ]
    if not candidates:
        raise SystemExit(f"no python module under {root}")
    return max(candidates, key=lambda path: path.stat().st_size)


def child(args: list[str], env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    import os

    full_env = dict(os.environ)
    if env:
        full_env.update(env)
    done = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        check=False,
        env=full_env,
        timeout=3600,
    )
    return done.returncode, done.stdout.strip(), done.stderr.strip()


def copy_db(src: Path, dst: Path) -> None:
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
        candidate = Path(str(src) + suffix)
        if candidate.exists():
            shutil.copy2(candidate, Path(str(dst) + suffix))


def write_checkpoint(directory: Path, name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (directory / f"{name}.done").write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dump compare


def compare_dumps(db_a: Path, db_b: Path, root: Path, commit: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """dump_index byte-equivalence of two databases of the same workspace state."""
    import hashlib
    import pickle

    p28 = load_p28()
    p28.WORKSPACE_DIR = root
    p28.BASE_COMMIT = commit
    workspace = p28.make_workspace_object()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "tests"))
    import importlib

    # runtime-only path injection (tests/support); dynamic import keeps mypy/ruff clean
    dump_index = importlib.import_module("support.indexdump").dump_index

    sections = ("files", "symbols", "edges")
    dumps: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
    for db in (db_a, db_b):
        stores = p28.open_db(db, fresh=False)
        try:
            dumps.append(dump_index(stores, workspace.repository_id))
        finally:
            p28.close_db(stores)

    def digest(dump: tuple[Any, ...]) -> dict[str, str]:
        whole = hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(dump, protocol=5)).hexdigest()
        per = {
            name: hashlib.sha256(pickle.dumps(part, protocol=5)).hexdigest()
            for name, part in zip(sections, dump, strict=True)
        }
        return {"whole": whole, **per}

    digest_a, digest_b = digest(dumps[0]), digest(dumps[1])
    first_diff: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if digest_a["whole"] != digest_b["whole"]:
        for name, part_a, part_b in zip(sections, dumps[0], dumps[1], strict=True):
            if part_a != part_b:
                rows_a = {repr(row) for row in part_a}
                rows_b = {repr(row) for row in part_b}
                first_diff = {
                    "section": name,
                    "rows_a": len(part_a),
                    "rows_b": len(part_b),
                    "only_in_a_sample": sorted(rows_a - rows_b)[:3],
                    "only_in_b_sample": sorted(rows_b - rows_a)[:3],
                }
                break
    return {
        "db_a": str(db_a),
        "db_b": str(db_b),
        "equal": digest_a["whole"] == digest_b["whole"],
        "sha_a": digest_a,
        "sha_b": digest_b,
        "first_diff": first_diff,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- driver


def drive(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    scratch = Path(args.scratch).resolve()
    dbroot = Path(args.dbroot).resolve()
    out = Path(args.out).resolve()
    checkpoints = Path(args.checkpoint_dir).resolve()
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    export_dir = scratch / "realrepo"
    commit = pinned_head(repo, args.pin_commit)

    marker = export_dir / ".export-head"
    if args.reuse_export and marker.exists() and marker.read_text().strip() == commit:
        export = {
            "source_repo": str(repo),
            "source_head": commit,
            "exported_files": sum(1 for p in export_dir.rglob("*") if p.is_file()),
            "reused": True,
        }
    else:
        export = export_tracked(repo, export_dir, commit)
        export["reused"] = False

    probe = pick_probe_file(export_dir)
    original = probe.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def apply_state(state: str | None) -> None:
        if state is None:
            probe.write_text(original, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        elif state == "probe42":
            probe.write_text(original + PROBE, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        elif state == "probe43":
            probe.write_text(original + PROBE_BODY, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        else:
            raise AssertionError(state)

    def db_for(scenario: str) -> Path:
        return dbroot.parent / f"{dbroot.name}-{scenario}" / "index.sqlite3"

    child_env: dict[str, str] = {}
    if args.parse_cache_dir:
        cache_dir = Path(args.parse_cache_dir).resolve()
        cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        child_env["CODEPILOT_PARSE_CACHE_DIR"] = str(cache_dir)

    runs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    durations: dict[str, float] = {}
    prefix = f"index-profile-{args.tag}" if args.tag != "baseline" else "index-profile"

    plan: list[tuple[str, str | None, bool, str | None]] = [
        # (scenario, workspace state before run, fresh db, copy-from scenario)
        ("cold", None, True, None),
        ("nochange", None, False, "cold"),
        ("change", "probe42", False, "nochange"),
        ("change_body", "probe43", False, "change"),
    ]
    if not args.no_verify:
        plan.append(("verify_change", "probe42", True, None))
        plan.append(("verify_change_body", "probe43", True, None))

    for scenario, state, fresh, chain_from in plan:
        apply_state(state)
        db = db_for(scenario)
        if fresh:
            for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
                candidate = Path(str(db) + suffix)
                if candidate.exists():
                    candidate.unlink()
        elif chain_from is not None:
            copy_db(db_for(chain_from), db)
        db.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        code, stdout, stderr = child(
            [
                "--run",
                scenario,
                "--db",
                str(db),
                "--root",
                str(export_dir),
                "--source-commit",
                commit,
            ],
            env=child_env or None,
        )
        durations[scenario] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4)
        if code != 0:
            print(f"child {scenario} failed rc={code}\nSTDOUT:\n{stdout}\nSTDERR:\n{stderr}")
            write_checkpoint(
                checkpoints,
                f"{prefix}-{scenario}",
                {"scenario": scenario, "rc": code, "stderr_tail": stderr[-2000:]},
            )
            return code
        run = json.loads(stdout)
        runs.append(run)
        write_checkpoint(
            checkpoints,
            f"{prefix}-{scenario}",
            {
                "scenario": scenario,
                "tag": args.tag,
                "rc": 0,
                "db": str(db),
                "wall_index_s": run["wall_index_s"],
                "child_process_wall_s": durations[scenario],
                "finished_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            },
        )
        print(
            f"[{args.tag}] {scenario}: wall_index={run['wall_index_s']}s "
            f"child={durations[scenario]}s parsed={run['parsed']} "
            f"fast={run['fast_mode']} mode={run['association_mode']}",
            flush=True,
        )

    apply_state(None)  # leave the export pristine

    for run in runs:
        run["child_process_wall_s"] = durations[run["scenario"]]

    verification: dict[str, Any] = {"pairs": []}
    if not args.no_verify:
        pairs = [
            ("nochange", "cold"),
            ("change", "verify_change"),
            ("change_body", "verify_change_body"),
        ]
        for incremental, reference in pairs:
            result = compare_dumps(db_for(incremental), db_for(reference), export_dir, commit)
            result["pair"] = f"{incremental} vs {reference}"
            verification["pairs"].append(result)
            print(f"[{args.tag}] verify {result['pair']}: equal={result['equal']}", flush=True)
        verification["all_equal"] = all(pair["equal"] for pair in verification["pairs"])

    payload = {
        "phase": "phase33-t05",
        "tag": args.tag,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "export": export,
        "pinned_commit": commit,
        "probe_file": str(probe.relative_to(export_dir)).replace("\\", "/"),
        "probe_edit": PROBE.strip(),
        "parse_cache_dir": args.parse_cache_dir,
        "association_mode": runs[-1]["association_mode"],
        "runs": runs,
        "verification": verification,
    }
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"[{args.tag}] wrote {out}")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Phase33 T05 index profile driver")
    parser.add_argument("--repo", default=str(REPO_ROOT))
    parser.add_argument(
        "--run",
        choices=[
            "cold",
            "nochange",
            "change",
            "change_body",
            "verify_change",
            "verify_change_body",
        ],
    )
    parser.add_argument("--db")
    parser.add_argument("--root")
    parser.add_argument("--source-commit", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--fresh", action="store_true", help="child mode: delete the db first")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", help="child mode: write a .done checkpoint here")
    parser.add_argument("--compare", nargs=2, metavar=("DB_A", "DB_B"))
    parser.add_argument("--tag", default="baseline")
    parser.add_argument("--scratch", default=str(DEFAULT_SCRATCH))
    parser.add_argument("--dbroot", default=str(DEFAULT_DBROOT))
    parser.add_argument("--out", default=str(DEFAULT_OUT))
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_CHECKPOINTS))
    parser.add_argument("--pin-commit", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--reuse-export", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--no-verify", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parse-cache-dir",
        default="",
        help="set CODEPILOT_PARSE_CACHE_DIR for children (persistent parse cache)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.compare:
        if not args.root:
            raise SystemExit("--compare needs --root (workspace the DBs indexed)")
        result = compare_dumps(
            Path(args.compare[0]), Path(args.compare[1]), Path(args.root), args.source_commit
        )
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        return 0 if result["equal"] else 1

    if args.run:
        if not args.db or not args.root:
            raise SystemExit("--run needs --db and --root")
        result = run_one(
            args.run, Path(args.db), Path(args.root), args.source_commit, fresh=args.fresh
        )
        print(json.dumps(result))
        if args.checkpoint:
            write_checkpoint(
                Path(args.checkpoint).parent,
                Path(args.checkpoint).name.removesuffix(".done"),

            )
        return 0

    return drive(args)

"""Phase32 T08: one minimal official SWE-bench image case (no pulls, no network).

Why: Phase32 has to show that the Docker execution path still works, using only
images already on this daemon. This script reuses the official instance image for
``psf__requests-3362`` and a copy of the Phase21 prepared workspace, runs exactly
one already-collected test, and writes the raw container outcome next to the
scratch tree.

testdeps into the workspace, and historical evidence directories stay read-only.

Usage: ``.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_official_probe.py``
Output: ``.codex-pytest-tmp/phase32/official-probe.json``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import stat

import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def git(*args: str, cwd: Path) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
    ).stdout.strip()


def clear_readonly(func: Any, path: str, _exc: Any) -> None:
    """git pack files are read-only on Windows; clear the bit and retry once."""
    Path(path).chmod(stat.S_IWRITE)
    func(path)


def remove_tree(path: Path) -> None:
    shutil.rmtree(path, onerror=clear_readonly)


def prepare_workspace() -> Path:
    if COPY.exists():
        remove_tree(COPY)
    shutil.copytree(
        SOURCE_WORKSPACE,
        COPY,
        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".pytest_cache", "__pycache__"),
    )
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=COPY)
    if head != BASE_COMMIT:
        raise SystemExit(f"workspace HEAD {head!r} != {BASE_COMMIT!r}")
    return COPY

    sandbox = OfficialInstanceSandbox(
        artifacts=ArtifactStore(ARTIFACTS, "light"),
        allowed_workspace_root=workspace.parent,
        instance_id=INSTANCE,
        images=images,
        runners=runners,
    )
    started = datetime.now(UTC)
    environment = sandbox.build_env(
        repository=task.repo,
        base_commit=BASE_COMMIT,
        workspace=workspace,
        env_spec=task.env_spec,
    )
    result = sandbox.run_tests(
        workspace=workspace,
        environment=environment,
        env_spec=task.env_spec,
        tests=[TEST],
        artifact_iteration=1,
    )
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "phase": 32,
        "instance_id": INSTANCE,
        "base_commit": BASE_COMMIT,
        "test": TEST,
        "started_at": started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "finished_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "image": sandbox.last_image,
        "environment": environment.model_dump(mode="json"),
        "status": result.status.value,
        "duration_seconds": result.duration_seconds,
        "error_reason": result.error_reason,
        "exit_code": getattr(result, "exit_code", None),
        "tests": [test.model_dump(mode="json") for test in result.tests],
    }
    OUT.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "instance_id": INSTANCE,

                    (test.get("node_id") or test.get("name"), test["outcome"])
                    for test in payload["tests"]

            },
            indent=2,

    return 0 if str(payload["status"]).lower().startswith("pass") else 1

"""Phase32 T07 / Phase33 T01: provider matrix, zero cost by construction.

Why this shape: the Phase32 budget gate (PHASE32_REAL_BUDGET_CNY) is unset in this
session, so no real request may be issued. Instead of claiming "verified", this
script records exactly two things:

1. what the fake/loopback suites prove (streaming, usage accounting, delayed
   headers, slow bodies, total deadline, cancellation isolation, no hidden retry),
2. the state of the real-provider rows: blocked by default, with the missing
   environment items named per row, 0 requests / 0 cost.

Phase33 adds a real execution path behind an explicit flag:

    scripts/phase32_provider_matrix.py --real

--real issues AT MOST ONE request per provider (three total) and only when
PHASE32_REAL_BUDGET_CNY > 0 (capped at 20 CNY) AND that provider's credentials
and model id are present in the environment. Hidden retries are disabled on
purpose (RetryPolicy(max_attempts=1); boto3 retries max_attempts=1) so
real_requests always equals the number of dispatched calls. A real row is only
one of three statuses:

- real-verified: the provider returned a complete, acknowledged usage record;
- real-failed: a request was dispatched and failed (status code / exception kept);
- blocked: budget, credentials, region or model id missing — nothing dispatched.

Costs come from the existing usage ledger (codepilot.schemas.usage.Usage via
UsageTrackingProvider) and the price table in configs/llm.yaml. When no complete
CNY-convertible price is configured for the probed model, the row reports
cost_known=false instead of inventing a number.

Attribution rule: each protocol row lists the test modules that cover it. Rows
overlap on purpose (the deadline suite covers every HTTP protocol), so the row
counts must never be summed into a "total tests" claim; the junit totals are the
only authoritative number.

Usage: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/phase32_provider_matrix.py [--real]
       [--out PATH] [--scratch DIR] [--llm-config PATH]
       [--real-model-openai ID] [--real-model-anthropic ID] [--real-model-bedrock ID]

Default output: .codex-pytest-tmp/phase32/provider-matrix.json and
docs/notes/phase32-provider-matrix.json. With --out the payload is written ONLY
to that path; with --scratch the junit/log/json artifacts move to that directory
and the docs copy is left untouched.

Environment for the real channel (each provider checked independently):
- openai-compatible: OPENAI_API_KEY + OPENAI_BASE_URL + PHASE32_REAL_MODEL_OPENAI
- anthropic: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + PHASE32_REAL_MODEL_ANTHROPIC
  (optional ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, default https://api.anthropic.com)
- bedrock: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY + importable boto3/botocore
  + AWS_REGION (or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION) + PHASE32_REAL_MODEL_BEDROCK
"""

def locate_rg() -> str:
    found = shutil.which("rg")
    if found:
        return found
    for candidate in RG_CANDIDATES:
        if candidate.is_file():
            return str(candidate)
    raise SystemExit("ripgrep not found; the retrieval suite needs it on PATH")


def child_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["PATH"] = str(Path(locate_rg()).parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
    env["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    env["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"
    return env


def budget() -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = os.environ.get(BUDGET_ENV)
    value: float | None = None
    if raw not in (None, ""):
        try:
            value = float(raw)
        except ValueError:
            value = None
    allowed = value is not None and value > 0
    effective = min(value, BUDGET_CAP_CNY) if allowed and value is not None else None
    return {
        "env": BUDGET_ENV,
        "raw_present": raw not in (None, ""),
        "budget_cny": value,
        "cap_cny": BUDGET_CAP_CNY,
        "effective_budget_cny": effective,
        "capped": bool(allowed and value is not None and value > BUDGET_CAP_CNY),
        "real_requests_allowed": allowed,
    }


def credentials_present() -> dict[str, bool]:
    names = [
        "OPENAI_API_KEY",
        "OPENAI_BASE_URL",
        "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
        "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
        "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
        "AWS_REGION",
        "AWS_DEFAULT_REGION",
    ]
    presence = {name: bool(os.environ.get(name)) for name in names}
    for module in ("boto3", "botocore"):
        try:
            __import__(module)
        except ImportError:
            presence[module + "_installed"] = False
        else:
            presence[module + "_installed"] = True
    return presence


def run_pytest(junit: Path, log: Path, basetemp: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    for path in (junit, log):
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        "pytest",
        *MODULES,
        "-q",
        "-p",
        "no:cacheprovider",
        "--basetemp=" + str(basetemp),
        "--junitxml=" + str(junit),
    ]
    done = subprocess.run(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=child_env(),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        check=False,
    )
    log.write_text((done.stdout or "") + (done.stderr or ""), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    tail = [line for line in (done.stdout or "").splitlines() if line.strip()][-1:]

    def _rel(path: Path) -> str:
        try:
            return str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
        except ValueError:
            return str(path)

    return {
        "command": " ".join(command),
        "exit_code": done.returncode,
        "log": _rel(log),
        "junit": _rel(junit) if junit.is_file() else None,
        "summary": tail,
    }


def junit_cases(junit: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    if not junit.is_file():
        return []
    tree = ET.parse(junit)
    cases: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for case in tree.iter("testcase"):
        outcome = "passed"
        for child in case:
            if child.tag in {"failure", "error", "skipped"}:
                outcome = child.tag
                break
        cases.append(
            {
                "classname": case.get("classname", ""),
                "name": case.get("name", ""),
                "outcome": outcome,
                "time": case.get("time", ""),
            }
        )
    return cases


def attribute(cases: list[dict[str, str]], modules: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    prefixes = tuple(module.removesuffix(".py").replace("/", ".") for module in modules)
    chosen = [
        case for case in cases if any(case["classname"].startswith(prefix) for prefix in prefixes)
    ]
    counts: dict[str, int] = {"passed": 0, "failure": 0, "error": 0, "skipped": 0}
    for case in chosen:
        counts[case["outcome"]] += 1
    return {"module_tests": counts, "node_count": len(chosen)}

# Real channel (Phase33 T01)

def resolve_model_id(key: str, overrides: dict[str, str | None] | None) -> str | None:
    override = (overrides or {}).get(key)
    raw = override or os.environ.get(REAL_PROVIDERS[key]["model_env"]) or ""
    raw = raw.strip()
    return raw or None


def row_missing(
    key: str,
    plan: dict[str, Any],
    model_id: str | None,
    *,
    spent_cny: float | None = None,
    creds: dict[str, bool] | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Per-row missing list: every provider row names its OWN gaps.

    Never share one list between rows — that was the D1 defect: a single
    missing_real list was copied onto all three rows. When ``creds`` is given
    (the ``credentials_present()`` map) the gate reads that map instead of
    re-probing the environment, so presence is computed exactly once.
    """
    meta = REAL_PROVIDERS[key]
    missing: list[str] = []
    effective = plan.get("effective_budget_cny")
    if not plan["real_requests_allowed"]:
        missing.append(BUDGET_ENV + " > 0")
    elif spent_cny is not None and effective is not None and spent_cny >= effective:
        missing.append(
            f"{BUDGET_ENV} exhausted: spent {spent_cny:.6f} CNY >= "
            f"effective cap {effective:.6f} CNY"
        )
    for name in meta["required_env"]:
        present = bool(creds.get(name)) if creds is not None else bool(os.environ.get(name))
        if not present:
            missing.append(name)
    for module in meta.get("required_modules", ()):
        if creds is not None:
            installed = bool(creds.get(module + "_installed"))
        else:
            try:
                __import__(module)
            except ImportError:
                installed = False
            else:
                installed = True
        if not installed:
            missing.append(module + " importable")
    region_env = meta.get("region_env")
    if region_env and not (
        any(creds.get(name) for name in region_env)
        if creds is not None
        else any(os.environ.get(name) for name in region_env)
    ):
        missing.append(" or ".join(region_env))
    if not model_id:
        missing.append(meta["model_env"])
    return missing


def _load_llm_config(path: Path) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
    """Best-effort config load: prices come from the existing table, never invented."""
    try:
        from codepilot.llm.config import load_llm_config

        return load_llm_config(path), None
    except Exception as exc:  # a broken config must not crash the matrix
        return None, (
            f"llm config {path} unavailable ({type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}); "
            "prices treated as unknown"
        )


def usable_price(cfg: Any, model_id: str) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
    """Reuse the configured price for this exact model id, or stay unknown.

    A price is only usable when it is complete AND convertible to the budget
    currency without guessing: cost.convert() silently falls back to rate 1.0
    for missing exchange rates, which would under-count a USD price as CNY.
    """
    if cfg is None:
        return None, None
    spec = next(
        (m for m in cfg.models.values() if m.model == model_id or m.alias == model_id),
        None,
    )
    if spec is None or spec.price is None:
        return None, f"no price configured for model {model_id!r}; cost stays unknown"
    price = spec.price
    if not price.is_complete:
        return None, f"price for model {model_id!r} is incomplete; cost stays unknown"
    if price.currency != cfg.budget_currency and price.currency not in cfg.exchange_rates:
        return None, (
            f"price for model {model_id!r} is in {price.currency} with no exchange "
            f"rate to {cfg.budget_currency}; cost stays unknown"
        )
    return price, None


class CountingBedrockClient:
    """Wraps a bedrock-runtime client and counts converse dispatches.

    BedrockConverseProvider has no attempts counter, and real_requests must
    equal the number of actually dispatched calls — so the count lives here.
    """

    def __init__(self, inner: Any) -> None:
        self._inner = inner
        self.converse_calls = 0

    def converse(self, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        self.converse_calls += 1
        return self._inner.converse(**kwargs)

    def close(self) -> None:
        closer = getattr(self._inner, "close", None)
        if callable(closer):
            closer()

    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        return getattr(self._inner, name)


def _default_bedrock_client(pspec: Any) -> Any:
    from codepilot.llm.bedrock_converse import _build_client

    return _build_client(pspec)


def _dispatched(inner: Any, counter: CountingBedrockClient | None) -> int:
    if counter is not None:
        return counter.converse_calls
    return int(getattr(inner, "attempts", 0) or 0)


def probe_provider(
    key: str,
    model_id: str,
    *,
    cfg: Any,
    cfg_note: str | None,
    usage: Any,
    http_client_factory: Any = None,
    bedrock_client_factory: Any = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Dispatch exactly ONE probe request for one provider and report honestly.

    No hidden retries: RetryPolicy(max_attempts=1) for the HTTP protocols and
    ProviderSpec(max_retries=0) so boto3 configures retries max_attempts=1.
    """
    import httpx

    from codepilot.llm.anthropic_messages import AnthropicMessagesProvider
    from codepilot.llm.bedrock_converse import BedrockConverseProvider
    from codepilot.llm.config import ModelSpec, ProviderSpec
    from codepilot.llm.openai_compatible import OpenAICompatibleProvider
    from codepilot.llm.retry import RetryPolicy
    from codepilot.llm.tracking import UsageTrackingProvider
    from codepilot.llm.types import LLMRequest, Message
    from codepilot.net import build_http_client
    from codepilot.observability.redaction import redact_text

    meta = REAL_PROVIDERS[key]
    price, price_note = usable_price(cfg, model_id) if cfg is not None else (None, cfg_note)
    row: dict[str, Any] = {
        "row": meta["row"],
        "provider": key,
        "model": model_id,
        "missing": [],
    }
    if price_note:
        row["cost_note"] = price_note

    common: dict[str, Any] = {
        "name": key,
        "protocol": meta["protocol"],
        "max_retries": 0,  # boto3 standard-mode retries collapse to 1 attempt
        "timeout_seconds": PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        "max_concurrency": 1,
    }
    if key == "bedrock":
        region = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or ""
        pspec = ProviderSpec(base_url="", region=region, **common)
    elif key == "anthropic":
        base_url = (os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL") or "https://api.anthropic.com").rstrip("/")
        pspec = ProviderSpec(base_url=base_url, **common)
    else:
        pspec = ProviderSpec(base_url=os.environ["OPENAI_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/"), **common)
    mspec = ModelSpec(
        alias="phase33-real-" + key,
        provider=key,
        model=model_id,
        max_output_tokens=PROBE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
        price=price,
    )
    policy = RetryPolicy(max_attempts=1)
    rates = dict(cfg.exchange_rates) if cfg is not None else {}
    currency = cfg.budget_currency if cfg is not None else "CNY"
    counter: CountingBedrockClient | None = None
    try:
        if meta["protocol"] == "bedrock_converse":
            client = (
                bedrock_client_factory(pspec)
                if bedrock_client_factory is not None
                else _default_bedrock_client(pspec)
            )
            counter = CountingBedrockClient(client)
            inner: Any = BedrockConverseProvider(
                spec=mspec,
                provider=pspec,
                client=counter,
                exchange_rates=rates,
                budget_currency=currency,
            )
        else:
            api_key = os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" if key == "anthropic" else "OPENAI_API_KEY"]
            if http_client_factory is not None:
                client = http_client_factory(pspec, api_key)
            else:
                client = build_http_client(
                    base_url=pspec.base_url,
                    timeout=httpx.Timeout(
                        pspec.timeout_seconds, connect=min(10.0, pspec.timeout_seconds)
                    ),
                    trust_env=pspec.trust_env,
                )
            provider_cls = (
                AnthropicMessagesProvider if key == "anthropic" else OpenAICompatibleProvider
            )
            inner = provider_cls(
                spec=mspec,
                provider=pspec,
                api_key=api_key,
                client=client,
                policy=policy,
                exchange_rates=rates,
                budget_currency=currency,
            )
    except Exception as exc:  # construction failure dispatches nothing
        row.update(
            status="blocked",
            missing=[
                f"provider construction failed: {type(exc).__name__}: "
                + redact_text(str(exc))[:300]
            ],
            real_requests=0,
        )
        return row

    tracked = UsageTrackingProvider(
        inner,
        usage=usage,
        node="phase33-matrix-" + key,
        role="phase33_provider_matrix",
        provider=key,
    )
    request = LLMRequest(
        messages=[Message.user(PROBE_TEXT)],
        max_output_tokens=PROBE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
        purpose=PROBE_PURPOSE,
    )
    try:
        response = tracked.complete(request)
    except Exception as exc:  # every dispatched failure is reported, not hidden
        # KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit are control flow, not provider results:
        # they must propagate instead of being turned into a "real-failed" row.
        row.update(
            status="real-failed",
            real_requests=_dispatched(inner, counter),
            error={
                "type": type(exc).__name__,
                "status": getattr(exc, "status", None),
                "uncertain": bool(getattr(exc, "uncertain", False)),
                "message": redact_text(str(exc))[:500],
            },
            cost_cny=0.0,
            cost_known=False,
        )
        return row
    finally:
        # close must never mask the result
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            inner.close()

    unacknowledged = int(getattr(inner, "unacknowledged", 0) or 0)
    usage_complete = response.input_tokens > 0 and response.output_tokens > 0
    if usage_complete and unacknowledged == 0:
        status = "real-verified"
    else:
        status = "real-failed"
        row["failure_reason"] = (
            f"unacknowledged transport errors: {unacknowledged}"
            if unacknowledged
            else "response did not include complete usage (input_tokens and output_tokens must be > 0)"
        )
    row.update(
        status=status,
        real_requests=_dispatched(inner, counter),
        input_tokens=response.input_tokens,
        output_tokens=response.output_tokens,
        cached_input_tokens=response.cached_input_tokens,
        finish_reason=response.finish_reason,
        cost_cny=response.cost,
        cost_known=response.cost_known,
    )
    return row


def run_real_channels(
    plan: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    llm_config_path: Path = DEFAULT_LLM_CONFIG,
    model_overrides: dict[str, str | None] | None = None,
    http_client_factory: Any = None,
    bedrock_client_factory: Any = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run the real channel: at most one request per provider, three total."""
    from codepilot.schemas.usage import Usage

    creds = credentials_present()
    usage = Usage()
    cfg, cfg_note = (None, None)
    if plan["real_requests_allowed"]:
        cfg, cfg_note = _load_llm_config(llm_config_path)

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    total_requests = 0
    for key in REAL_PROVIDER_ORDER:
        model_id = resolve_model_id(key, model_overrides)
        missing = row_missing(key, plan, model_id, spent_cny=usage.cost, creds=creds)
        if missing or not model_id:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "row": REAL_PROVIDERS[key]["row"],
                    "provider": key,
                    "model": model_id,
                    "status": "blocked",
                    "missing": missing,
                    "real_requests": 0,
                }
            )
            continue
        row = probe_provider(
            key,
            model_id,
            cfg=cfg,
            cfg_note=cfg_note,
            usage=usage,
            http_client_factory=http_client_factory,
            bedrock_client_factory=bedrock_client_factory,
        )
        rows.append(row)
        total_requests += int(row.get("real_requests") or 0)

    return {
        "budget": plan,
        "credentials_present": creds,
        "rows": rows,
        "real_requests": total_requests,
        "real_cost_cny": round(usage.cost, 8),
        "cost_known": usage.cost_unknown_calls == 0,
        "cost_unknown_calls": usage.cost_unknown_calls,
        "cost_is_lower_bound": usage.cost_is_lower_bound,
        "llm_calls": usage.llm_calls,
        "input_tokens": usage.input_tokens,
        "output_tokens": usage.output_tokens,
        "note": (
            "--real was requested: at most one request per provider was dispatched "
            "(no hidden retries). Costs come from the usage ledger; cost_known=false "
            "wherever no complete CNY-convertible price is configured."
        ),
    }


def blocked_real_provider(
    plan: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    model_overrides: dict[str, str | None] | None = None,
    real_requested: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Default (no --real) real section: every row blocked, 0 requests, per-row missing."""
    creds = credentials_present()
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for key in REAL_PROVIDER_ORDER:
        model_id = resolve_model_id(key, model_overrides)
        missing = row_missing(key, plan, model_id, creds=creds)
        if not real_requested:
            missing.insert(0, "--real flag (real channel disabled by default)")
        rows.append(
            {
                "row": REAL_PROVIDERS[key]["row"],
                "provider": key,
                "model": model_id,
                "status": "blocked",
                "missing": missing,
                "real_requests": 0,
            }
        )
    return {
        "budget": plan,
        "credentials_present": creds,
        "rows": rows,
        "real_requests": 0,
        "real_cost_cny": 0.0,
        "cost_known": True,
        "cost_unknown_calls": 0,
        "cost_is_lower_bound": False,
        "llm_calls": 0,
        "input_tokens": 0,
        "output_tokens": 0,
        "note": (
            "No real request was issued in this run. Zero-cost fake coverage is "
            "not a substitute for a real-provider row and is not reported as one."
            + ("" if real_requested else " Pass --real to enable the real channel.")
        ),
    }


def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Phase32 provider matrix: fake coverage plus the optional real channel."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--real",
        action="store_true",
        help=(
            "enable the real channel: at most one request per provider, gated by "
            + BUDGET_ENV
            + " > 0 (capped at 20 CNY) and per-provider credentials"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="write the JSON payload ONLY to this path (skips scratch + docs copies)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--scratch",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="scratch directory for junit/log/json artifacts (default .codex-pytest-tmp/phase32)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--llm-config",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_LLM_CONFIG,
        help="price table used by the real channel (default configs/llm.yaml)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--real-model-openai", default=None, help="model id for the openai-compatible probe"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--real-model-anthropic", default=None, help="model id for the anthropic probe"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--real-model-bedrock", default=None, help="model id for the bedrock probe")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    scratch = args.scratch if args.scratch is not None else SCRATCH
    if not scratch.is_absolute():
        scratch = ROOT / scratch
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    junit = scratch / "provider-matrix.xml"
    log = scratch / "provider-matrix.log"
    plan = budget()
    creds = credentials_present()
    result = run_pytest(junit, log, scratch / "pytest-basetemp")
    cases = junit_cases(junit)
    rows = []
    for row in ROWS:
        entry: dict[str, Any] = {
            "protocol": row["protocol"],
            "mode": row["mode"],
            "modules": row["modules"],
            "covers": row["covers"],
            "result": attribute(cases, list(row["modules"])),
            "status": "fake-verified",
        }
        if row["protocol"] == "bedrock" and not creds.get("botocore_installed"):
            entry["status"] = "fake-verified (botocore missing: client is stubbed)"
        rows.append(entry)

    model_overrides = {
        "openai-compatible": args.real_model_openai,
        "anthropic": args.real_model_anthropic,
        "bedrock": args.real_model_bedrock,
    }
    if args.real:
        real_section = run_real_channels(
            plan,
            llm_config_path=args.llm_config,
            model_overrides=model_overrides,
        )
    else:
        real_section = blocked_real_provider(plan, model_overrides=model_overrides)

    totals = {
        "tests": len(cases),
        "failures": sum(1 for case in cases if case["outcome"] == "failure"),
        "errors": sum(1 for case in cases if case["outcome"] == "error"),
        "skipped": sum(1 for case in cases if case["outcome"] == "skipped"),
    }
    payload = {
        "tool": "phase32-provider-matrix",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "real_mode": bool(args.real),
        "pytest": result,
        "totals_from_junit": totals,
        "fake_rows": rows,
        "real_provider": real_section,
        "overlap_note": "fake_rows overlap; never sum them into a test total",
    }
    text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    if args.out is not None:
        out = args.out if args.out.is_absolute() else ROOT / args.out
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    else:
        (scratch / "provider-matrix.json").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        if args.scratch is None:
            # Only a fully-default invocation refreshes the docs copy; any
            # redirect must never overwrite docs/notes/phase32-provider-matrix.json.
            DOCS_JSON.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
                "totals": totals,
                "real_mode": bool(args.real),
                "real_requests": real_section["real_requests"],
                "real_cost_cny": real_section["real_cost_cny"],
                "budget_allowed": plan["real_requests_allowed"],
            },
            indent=2,
        )
    )
    return 0 if result["exit_code"] == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
