tests/unit/repo/test_phase30_index_reexp:
"""Phase30 T07: incremental index re-export staleness (failing tests first).

A body-only edit that retargets an import (``from pkg.a import value`` ->
``from pkg.b import value``) keeps every symbol id, so the Phase29 fast path
engaged — but the resolution of every downstream file that re-exports THROUGH
the changed module changed too, and the fast path left those edges stale. The
contract (R-16, tests/support/indexdump.dump_index): an incremental re-index
must be field-identical to a fresh full index of the same workspace state,
indexed under the same ``repository_id`` (symbol ids embed it).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from codepilot.repo.index import Indexer
from codepilot.repo.parser import TreeSitterParser
from codepilot.repo.workspace import Workspace, normalize_source
from codepilot.storage.db import create_engine_from_url, create_session_factory, init_db
from codepilot.storage.repository import EdgeStore, Stores
from support.indexdump import dump_index

A_SRC = "def value() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
B_SRC = "def value() -> int:\n    return 2\n"
CONSUMER = "from pkg.hub import value\n\n\ndef use() -> int:\n    return value()\n"


def make_stores() -> Stores:
    engine = create_engine_from_url("sqlite://")
    init_db(engine)
    return Stores(create_session_factory(engine)())


def ws(path: Path, repository_id: str) -> Workspace:
    return Workspace(
        path=path,
        source=normalize_source(str(path)),
        base_commit="0" * 40,
        repository_id=repository_id,
    )


def index_fresh(root: Path, repository_id: str) -> tuple[Stores, Indexer]:
    stores = make_stores()
    indexer = Indexer(parser=TreeSitterParser())
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()
    return stores, indexer


def build_workspace(tmp_path: Path, name: str, *, alias: bool = False) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / name
    (root / "pkg").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "pkg" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "a.py").write_text(A_SRC, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "b.py").write_text(B_SRC, encoding="utf-8")
    hub_line = "from pkg.a import value as v\n" if alias else "from pkg.a import value\n"
    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text(hub_line, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "consumer.py").write_text(CONSUMER, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def capture_replace(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> dict[str, list]:
    calls: dict[str, list] = {"source_ids": []}
    original = EdgeStore.replace_for_sources

    def spy(self: EdgeStore, repository_id: str, source_ids: list[str], rows: object) -> None:
        calls["source_ids"].append(list(source_ids))
        return original(self, repository_id, source_ids, rows)

    monkeypatch.setattr(EdgeStore, "replace_for_sources", spy)
    return calls


def test_reexport_retarget_is_incrementally_equivalent(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """pkg/hub.py swaps its re-export source: downstream edges must follow."""
    root = build_workspace(tmp_path, "p30_reexport")
    repository_id = "repo_p30_reexport"
    stores, indexer = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    capture_replace(monkeypatch)

    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text("from pkg.b import value\n", encoding="utf-8")
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()

    ref_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    incremental = dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1:]
    full = dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1:]
    assert incremental == full, "incremental re-index diverged from a fresh full index"
    # The consumer must now resolve through pkg.b.value, not pkg.a.value.
    assert any("pkg.b.value" in repr(row) for row in full), (
        "consumer edges must resolve through the new re-export target"
    )


def test_reexport_alias_retarget_is_incrementally_equivalent(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """from pkg.a import value as v -> from pkg.b import value as v."""
    root = build_workspace(tmp_path, "p30_alias", alias=True)
    repository_id = "repo_p30_alias"
    stores, indexer = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    capture_replace(monkeypatch)

    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text("from pkg.b import value as v\n", encoding="utf-8")
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()

    ref_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    assert dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1:] == dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1:]


def test_two_level_reexport_chain_updates_downstream(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """consumer -> mid -> hub -> a/b: changing hub must refresh mid and consumer."""
    root = tmp_path / "p30_chain"
    (root / "pkg").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "pkg" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "a.py").write_text(A_SRC, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "b.py").write_text(B_SRC, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text("from pkg.a import value\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "mid.py").write_text("from pkg.hub import value\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "pkg" / "consumer.py").write_text(
        "from pkg.mid import value\n\n\ndef use() -> int:\n    return value()\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    repository_id = "repo_p30_chain"
    stores, indexer = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    capture_replace(monkeypatch)

    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text("from pkg.b import value\n", encoding="utf-8")
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()

    ref_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    assert dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1:] == dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1:], (
        "two-level re-export chain left stale edges"
    )


def test_consumer_symbol_set_unchanged_but_targets_moved(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """Same consumer symbols, different IMPORT/CALL targets after the retarget."""
    root = build_workspace(tmp_path, "p30_symbols")
    repository_id = "repo_p30_symbols"
    stores, indexer = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    capture_replace(monkeypatch)

    before_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    before = dump_index(before_stores, repository_id)[2]  # edges tuple

    (root / "pkg" / "hub.py").write_text("from pkg.b import value\n", encoding="utf-8")
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()

    ref_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    after = dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[2]
    assert before != after, "consumer edge targets must change with the re-export"
    assert dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1:] == dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1:]
    # Consumer symbol ids are unchanged: only the edge targets moved.
    assert dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1] == dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1]


def test_body_only_change_still_uses_fast_path(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """No import-binding change: the bounded fast path must stay engaged."""
    root = build_workspace(tmp_path, "p30_body")
    repository_id = "repo_p30_body"
    stores, indexer = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    calls = capture_replace(monkeypatch)

    (root / "pkg" / "a.py").write_text(
        "def value() -> int:\n    return 10  # body-only\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    indexer.index(stores, ws(root, repository_id))
    stores.session.commit()

    total_symbols = len(stores.symbols.list_by_repo(repository_id))
    replaced = [ids for ids in calls["source_ids"] if ids]
    assert replaced, "changed file edges must still be replaced"
    for ids in replaced:
        assert len(ids) < total_symbols, (
            f"body-only change must not rewrite the whole graph: {len(ids)} >= {total_symbols}"
        )
    ref_stores, _ = index_fresh(root, repository_id)
    assert dump_index(stores, repository_id)[1:] == dump_index(ref_stores, repository_id)[1:]

"""F-13 的证明：写入→读回一致；重复写入按主键 upsert。

外加两条不写在清单里、但漏掉就会在生产里咬人的断言：
外键真的生效（SQLite 默认关闭），以及 ``Stores`` 的九个 store 共享同一个
session（否则"写进去查不到"会以最费解的方式出现）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import Engine, text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker

from codepilot.storage.repository import Stores


def _repo(stores: Stores, repository_id: str = "r1") -> None:
    stores.repositories.upsert(
        repository_id=repository_id, url="https://example.invalid/x.git", base_commit="abc"
    )


def _file(stores: Stores, file_id: str = "f1", path: str = "src/a.py") -> None:
    stores.files.upsert_many(
        [
            {
                "id": file_id,
                "repository_id": "r1",
                "path": path,
                "sha256": "0" * 64,
                "line_count": 10,
            }
        ]
    )


def _symbol(
    stores: Stores,
    symbol_id: str = "s1",
    qualified_name: str = "a.f",
    name: str = "f",
    file_id: str = "f1",
) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "id": symbol_id,
        "file_id": file_id,
        "repository_id": "r1",
        "name": name,
        "qualified_name": qualified_name,
        "kind": "function",
        "start_line": 1,
        "end_line": 5,
    }


def test_repository_upsert_then_read_back(stores: Stores) -> None:
    _repo(stores)
    row = stores.repositories.get("r1")
    assert row is not None
    assert row.url == "https://example.invalid/x.git"
    assert row.base_commit == "abc"


def test_repository_upsert_is_idempotent_on_primary_key(stores: Stores) -> None:
    _repo(stores)
    stores.repositories.upsert(repository_id="r1", url="https://other.invalid", base_commit="def")
    assert stores.repositories.get("r1") is not None
    assert stores.repositories.find_by_url_commit("https://other.invalid", "def") is not None
    assert stores.repositories.find_by_url_commit("https://example.invalid/x.git", "abc") is None


def test_repository_mark_indexed_sets_timestamp(stores: Stores) -> None:
    _repo(stores)
    assert stores.repositories.get("r1").indexed_at is None  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    stores.repositories.mark_indexed("r1")
    assert stores.repositories.get("r1").indexed_at is not None  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def test_mark_indexed_on_missing_repository_raises(stores: Stores) -> None:
    """静默无操作会让"索引没建好"变成"索引建好了但查不到"，更难查。"""
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        stores.repositories.mark_indexed("nope")


def test_file_upsert_many_and_get_by_path(stores: Stores) -> None:
    _repo(stores)
    _file(stores)
    row = stores.files.get_by_path("r1", "src/a.py")
    assert row is not None
    assert row.line_count == 10


def test_file_upsert_updates_existing_row(stores: Stores) -> None:

                "id": "f1",

def test_file_parse_error_survives_a_later_clean_upsert(stores: Stores) -> None:

def test_delete_by_paths_returns_ids_and_cascades_to_symbols(stores: Stores) -> None:

    stores.session.flush()

def test_delete_by_paths_with_empty_input_is_noop(stores: Stores) -> None:

def test_edges_replace_for_sources_is_replace(stores: Stores) -> None:

def test_edge_with_unresolved_target_is_storable_and_queryable_by_name(

def test_foreign_keys_are_actually_enforced(
    db_engine: Engine, session_factory: sessionmaker[Session]
) -> None:
    """SQLite 默认**不**强制外键。

    如果 ``PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON`` 没生效，级联删除不会发生，孤儿行会慢慢
    堆积，而所有测试仍然是绿的。
    """
    assert db_engine.dialect.name == "sqlite"
    with session_factory() as session:
        value = session.execute(text("PRAGMA foreign_keys")).scalar()
    assert value == 1

PATCH = (
    "diff --git a/src/pkg/core.py b/src/pkg/core.py\n"
    "--- a/src/pkg/core.py\n"
    "+++ b/src/pkg/core.py\n"
    "@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@\n"
    " def normalize(value: int) -> int:\n"
    "-    return value - 1\n"
    "+    return value\n"
)
IDS = [f"owner{index}__repo{index}-{index}" for index in range(6)]


def _write_json(path: Path, payload: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")


def _ledger(path: Path, *, cost: float = 0.01, unknown: bool = False) -> None:
    record = (
        {"status": "unknown_frozen", "reserved_cny": 0.8114688}
        if unknown
        else {"status": "settled", "cost_cny": cost}
    )
    _write_json(
        path,
        {"currency": "CNY", "frozen": unknown, "requests": [record]},
    )


def _budget() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "max_iterations": 5,
        "max_test_runs": 18,
        "max_tool_calls_per_iteration": 30,
        "max_review_calls": 2,
        "max_runtime_seconds": 1800,
        "source": {"max_test_runs": "cli"},
    }


def _report(root: Path, batch: str, instance: str, suffix: str = "") -> str:
    run_id = f"run-{instance}{suffix}"
    candidate = patch_hash(PATCH)
    raw = hashlib.sha256(PATCH.encode()).hexdigest()
    run_dir = root / "runs" / run_id
    report = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "task_id": instance,
        "git_diff": PATCH,
        "patch_hash": raw,
        "reproduction": {"status": "reproduced"},
        "attempts": [
            {
                "iteration": 1,
                "patch_hash": candidate,
                "validation": {"passed": True},
                "target_test_source": "planner",
                "target_tests": ["tests/test_core.py::test_normalize"],
            }
        ],
        "review": {"approved": True, "reviewed_patch_hash": candidate, "issues": []},
        "budget": _budget(),
        "regression": {"mode": "full", "unexecuted_tests": []},
        "closure": {
            "patch_present": True,
            "candidate_patch_sha256": candidate,
            "validator_executed": True,
            "validator_passed": True,
            "target_tests_executed": True,
            "target_tests_status": "PASS",
            "target_test_sha256": candidate,
            "target_test_source": "planner",
            "target_tests": ["tests/test_core.py::test_normalize"],
            "regression_executed": True,
            "regression_complete": True,
            "regression_mode": "full",
            "regression_unexecuted_tests": 0,
            "regression_new_failures": 0,
            "review_executed": True,
            "review_approved": True,
            "review_high_issues": 0,
            "review_high_issues_known": True,
            "review_bound_to_candidate": True,
        },
    }
    _write_json(run_dir / "report.json", report)
    _write_json(run_dir / "review/1-model.json", {"request": PATCH, "patch": PATCH})
    prediction_path = root / "predictions" / f"{run_id}.jsonl"
    prediction_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    prediction_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "instance_id": instance,
                "model_name_or_path": "glm-5.3-flash-main",
                "model_patch": PATCH,
            }
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    prediction_sha = hashlib.sha256(prediction_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    root_report = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_label": batch,
        "status": "SMOKE_COMPLETED",
        "runtime": {"model_identity": "glm-5.3-flash-main"},
        "inference": {
            "simulated_llm": False,
            "sandbox_backend": "docker",
            "final_patch_sha256": raw,
        },
        "prediction": {
            "path": str(prediction_path),
            "predictions_sha256": prediction_sha,
            "manifest": {
                "run_id": run_id,
                "model_name_or_path": "glm-5.3-flash-main",
                "predictions_sha256": prediction_sha,
                "entries": [{"instance_id": instance, "patch_sha256": raw}],
            },
        },
    }
    _write_json(root / "reports" / f"{run_id}.json", root_report)
    return run_id


def _no_patch(root: Path, batch: str, instance: str) -> None:
    run_id = f"run-{instance}"
    empty = patch_hash("")
    report = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "task_id": instance,
        "git_diff": "",
        "patch_hash": "",
        "reproduction": {"status": "failed", "kind": "invalid_pass"},
        "attempts": [{"iteration": 1, "patch_hash": empty, "validation": {"passed": False}}],
        "review": None,
        "budget": _budget(),
        "regression": None,
        "closure": {
            "patch_present": False,
            "candidate_patch_sha256": empty,
            "validator_executed": True,
            "validator_passed": False,
            "target_tests_executed": False,
            "regression_executed": False,
            "regression_complete": False,
            "review_executed": False,
            "review_high_issues_known": False,
        },
    }
    _write_json(root / "runs" / run_id / "report.json", report)
    _write_json(
        root / "reports" / f"{run_id}.json",
        {
            "run_id": run_id,
            "run_label": batch,
            "inference": {
                "simulated_llm": False,
                "sandbox_backend": "docker",
                "final_patch_sha256": "",
            },
        },
    )


def _rejected(root: Path, batch: str, instance: str) -> None:
    run_id = _report(root, batch, instance)
    path = root / "runs" / run_id / "report.json"
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text())
    payload["review"]["approved"] = False
    payload["closure"]["review_approved"] = False
    _write_json(path, payload)

"""Phase 26 风险 C：时间估算的适用性与派发前后的边界（真实执行）。

重点不是"估算函数算得对不对"，而是 ``AccountingSandbox.run_tests`` 这条链：

- 旧候选（不同 identity）的慢样本不能影响新候选，也不能拦下派发；
- 余量不足时按 runner 上限受限派发，而不是直接拒绝；
- 资源拿到之前就停，不算一次测试运行；
- 范围不是精确节点集时如实记成 aggregate，不标 coverage；
- Review/closure 预留只扣一次。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from codepilot.graph.deps import AccountingSandbox
from codepilot.graph.validation_time import timing_identity
from codepilot.observability.dispatch import (
    Deadline,
    DispatchScope,
    DispatchStoppedError,
    dispatch_scope,
)
from codepilot.sandbox.base import EnvironmentBuildResult
from codepilot.sandbox.env_spec import EnvSpec
from codepilot.schemas.enums import ExecutionStatus
from codepilot.schemas.execution import ExecutionResult


def _identity(base: str, spec: EnvSpec, selectors: list[str]) -> str:
    environment = EnvironmentBuildResult(
        status=ExecutionStatus.PASS, image_id="image", cache_key="env"
    )
    return timing_identity(
        "",
        base,
        {**environment.model_dump(mode="json"), "runner_identity": "types.SimpleNamespace:pytest"},
        spec.model_dump(mode="json"),
        selectors,
    )


def _sandbox(seen: list[int], *, base: str = "") -> AccountingSandbox:
    def run_tests(**kwargs):
        seen.append(kwargs["env_spec"].timeout_seconds)
        # Windows 的单调时钟分辨率约 15.6ms，瞬间返回会被记成 0 秒并当作无效样本丢掉。
        time.sleep(0.05)
        return ExecutionResult(status=ExecutionStatus.PASS)

    sandbox = AccountingSandbox(SimpleNamespace(run_tests=run_tests))
    sandbox.base_commit = base
    return sandbox


def test_a_changed_candidate_ignores_old_slow_samples_and_still_dispatches(tmp_path):
    spec = EnvSpec(timeout_seconds=300)

    seen: list[int] = []
    sandbox = _sandbox(seen, base="new-base")
    sandbox.timing_facts = [
        {"identity": old_identity, "seconds": seconds, "complete": True, "status": "pass"}
        for seconds in (260, 270, 280)
    ]

    result = sandbox.run_tests(
        workspace=tmp_path,
        environment=EnvironmentBuildResult(
            status=ExecutionStatus.PASS, image_id="image", cache_key="env"
        ),
        env_spec=spec,
        tests=selectors,
    )

    allocation = result.diagnostics["time_allocation"]
    assert seen == [300]
    assert allocation["source"] == "conservative_default"
    assert allocation["complete_samples"] == 0
    assert allocation["margin_insufficient"] is False
    assert sandbox.runs == 1


def test_insufficient_margin_dispatches_with_the_runner_cap_not_a_refusal(tmp_path):
    spec = EnvSpec(timeout_seconds=300)
    selectors = ["test.py::test_one"]
    seen: list[int] = []
    sandbox = _sandbox(seen)
    identity = _identity("", spec, selectors)
    sandbox.timing_facts = [
        {"identity": identity, "seconds": 250, "complete": True, "status": "pass"},
        {"identity": identity, "seconds": 320, "status": "timeout"},
    ]

    result = sandbox.run_tests(
        workspace=tmp_path,
        environment=EnvironmentBuildResult(
            status=ExecutionStatus.PASS, image_id="image", cache_key="env"
        ),
        env_spec=spec,
        tests=selectors,
    )

    allocation = result.diagnostics["time_allocation"]
    assert seen == [300]
    assert allocation["suggested_seconds"] > 300
    assert allocation["final_timeout_seconds"] == 300
    assert allocation["margin_insufficient"] is True
    assert allocation["deadline_available_seconds"] == 300


def test_a_run_stopped_before_dispatch_does_not_count_or_record(tmp_path):
    spec = EnvSpec(timeout_seconds=300)
    seen: list[int] = []
    sandbox = _sandbox(seen)

    with (
        dispatch_scope(DispatchScope(Deadline(time.monotonic() + 0.2), reserve=0)),
        pytest.raises(DispatchStoppedError),
    ):
        sandbox.run_tests(
            workspace=tmp_path,
            environment=EnvironmentBuildResult(
                status=ExecutionStatus.PASS, image_id="image", cache_key="env"
            ),
            env_spec=spec,
            tests=["test.py::test_one"],
        )

    assert seen == []
    assert sandbox.runs == 0
    assert sandbox.timing_facts == []
    assert sandbox.run_log == []


def test_incomplete_scope_is_recorded_as_aggregate_evidence_only(tmp_path):
    spec = EnvSpec(timeout_seconds=300)
    selectors = ["test.py"]
    seen: list[int] = []
    sandbox = _sandbox(seen)
    environment = EnvironmentBuildResult(
        status=ExecutionStatus.PASS, image_id="image", cache_key="env"
    )

    first = sandbox.run_tests(
        workspace=tmp_path, environment=environment, env_spec=spec, tests=selectors
    )
    fact = first.diagnostics["timing_fact"]
    assert fact["complete"] is False
    assert fact["process_completed"] is True
    assert "aggregate" in fact["scope_note"]

    second = sandbox.run_tests(
        workspace=tmp_path, environment=environment, env_spec=spec, tests=selectors
    )
    allocation = second.diagnostics["time_allocation"]
    assert allocation["source"] == "conservative_default+exact_scope_aggregate" or (
        "exact_scope_aggregate" in allocation["source"]
    )
    assert allocation["coverage_reduced"] is False
    assert allocation["complete_samples"] == 0
    assert allocation["aggregate_samples"] == 1


def test_closure_reservation_is_deducted_once_from_the_remaining_window():
    with dispatch_scope(DispatchScope(Deadline(time.monotonic() + 30), reserve=10)):
        from codepilot.observability.dispatch import dispatch_timeout

        # 30 秒窗口扣一次 10 秒预留 = 20；扣两次会得到 10。
        assert dispatch_timeout(300) == 20
        # 给 runner 的上限仍然生效。
        assert dispatch_timeout(5) == 5

"""Phase28 archive generator tests: contract A (schema v2), temporary git fixtures only.

Zero network, zero Docker, zero model calls: every test drives a throwaway git
repository and a throwaway archive root under ``tmp_path``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from codepilot.archive import (
    GIT_NORMALIZATION_POLICY,
    NORMALIZATION_NOTE,
    ArchiveError,
    CandidateExistsError,
    DiffVerificationError,
    DirtyWorktreeError,
    MissingSourceError,
    create_candidate,
)
from codepilot.rsi import extract_prompts, validate_snapshot

CODER_SOURCE = '"""Coder fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "coder prompt fixture"\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return _SYSTEM\n'
PLANNER_SOURCE = '"""Planner fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "planner prompt fixture"\n'
REVIEWER_SOURCE = '"""Reviewer fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "reviewer prompt fixture"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n\n\ndef extra() -> str:\n    return 'extra'\n"
NOTE_V1 = "note v1\n"
NOTE_V2 = "note v2 changed\n"
UNLISTED_V1 = "unlisted v1\n"

SOURCE_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
    "src/feature.py",
    "docs/note.md",
)
ARCHIVE_FILES = ("candidate.diff", "candidate.json", "snapshot.json", "sources.json")


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def write_crlf(repo: Path, rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    """Write CRLF-terminated bytes so LF-normalized and raw hashes provably differ."""
    path = repo / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", "\r\n").encode("utf-8"))


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    """Commit a base tree, then the candidate change; the worktree stays clean."""
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "archive@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Archive Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/coder.py", CODER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1)
    write_crlf(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V1)
    write_crlf(repo, "unlisted.txt", UNLISTED_V1)
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    write_crlf(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V2)
    write_crlf(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V2)
    head = commit_all(repo, "candidate change")
    return repo, base, head


def generate(
    root: Path, repo: Path, version: str, base: str, head: str, **kwargs: Any
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version=version,
        parent=kwargs.pop("parent", None),
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(SOURCE_PATHS),
        **kwargs,
    )


def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return payload


def normalize(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    return raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").encode("utf-8")


def test_generate_writes_self_verifying_v2_directory(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"

    folder = root / "candidates" / "phase28-t-main"
    assert summary["directory"] == str(folder)
    assert summary["source_files"] == len(SOURCE_PATHS)
    assert summary["dirty_worktree"] is False and "dirty_files" not in summary
    assert sorted(path.name for path in folder.iterdir()) == sorted(ARCHIVE_FILES)
    assert not (root / "active.json").exists()
    assert not (root / "active.next.json").exists()

    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")

    assert candidate["parent"] is None

    assert candidate["source_origin"] == "git_commit"
    assert candidate["snapshot_ref"] == "snapshot.json"
    assert candidate["snapshot_hash_rule"] == "file_bytes_sha256"
    assert candidate["diff_base_commit"] == base
    assert candidate["source_commit"] == head
    assert candidate["source_files"] == len(SOURCE_PATHS)

    assert candidate["parent_integrity"] is None

    assert "code_revision" not in candidate

    assert set(candidate["base_hashes"]) == set(candidate["source_hashes"])
    sealed = {k: v for k, v in candidate.items() if k != "candidate_payload_sha256"}
    assert (
        candidate["candidate_payload_sha256"]
        == hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(sealed, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

    )

    snapshot = read_json(folder / "snapshot.json")
    assert snapshot["schema_version"] == 1
    assert snapshot["version"] == "phase28-t-main"

def test_hashes_recompute_independently_with_crlf_sources(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    summary = generate(root, repo, "phase28-t-hash", base, head)
    folder = Path(summary["directory"])
    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")

    assert (
        candidate["snapshot_file_sha256"]
        == hashlib.sha256((folder / "snapshot.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    )
    snapshot = read_json(folder / "snapshot.json")
    assert (
        candidate["snapshot_canonical_sha256"]
        == hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
    )
    diff = (folder / "candidate.diff").read_bytes()
    assert candidate["diff_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest()

    for rel in SOURCE_PATHS:
        blob = git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{head}:{rel}")
        assert candidate["source_hashes"][rel] == hashlib.sha256(normalize(blob)).hexdigest()
        base_blob = git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{base}:{rel}")
        assert candidate["base_hashes"][rel] == hashlib.sha256(normalize(base_blob)).hexdigest()
        assert (repo / rel).read_bytes() == blob, "clean worktree must equal the source commit"
    assert (
        candidate["source_hashes"]["src/feature.py"] != candidate["base_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]
    )

    assert integrity["declared_snapshot_sha256_field"] == "snapshot_file_sha256"
    assert integrity["file_bytes_consistent"] is True

    # Simulate a v1-style parent: only snapshot_sha256 is declared, with a wrong value.
    parent_candidate.pop("snapshot_file_sha256")

    (root / "candidates" / "phase28-t-parent" / "candidate.json").write_text(

tests/unit/test_phase28_archive_verify.p:
"""Phase28 archive verifier tests: temporary git fixtures only, never the real archive.

Zero network, zero Docker, zero model calls: every test drives a throwaway git
repository and a throwaway archive root under ``tmp_path``; the real
``configs/harness`` tree is never touched.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from codepilot.archive import create_candidate

CODER_SOURCE = '"""Coder fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "coder prompt fixture"\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return _SYSTEM\n'
PLANNER_SOURCE = '"""Planner fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "planner prompt fixture"\n'
REVIEWER_SOURCE = '"""Reviewer fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "reviewer prompt fixture"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n\n\ndef extra() -> str:\n    return 'extra'\n"
NOTE_V1 = "note v1\n"
NOTE_V2 = "note v2 changed\n"

SOURCE_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
    "src/feature.py",
    "docs/note.md",
)


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def write_file(repo: Path, rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    path = repo / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    """Commit a base tree, then the candidate change; the worktree stays clean."""
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "verify@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Verify Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write_file(repo, "agents/coder.py", CODER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V1)
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V2)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V2)
    head = commit_all(repo, "candidate change")
    return repo, base, head


def generate(root: Path, repo: Path, version: str, base: str, head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version=version,
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(SOURCE_PATHS),
    )


def load_cli_module() -> Any:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "phase28_archive_verify.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase28_archive_verify_cli", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def verify(
    cli: Any,
    tmp_path: Path,
    *,
    version: str | None = None,
    use_all: bool = False,
    archive_root: Path,
    repo: Path,
    json_name: str = "report.json",
    extra: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    json_path = tmp_path / json_name
    args: list[str] = []
    if use_all:
        args.append("--all")
    else:
        assert version is not None
        args += ["--version", version]
    args += [
        "--archive-root",
        str(archive_root),
        "--repo",
        str(repo),
        "--json",
        str(json_path),
        *extra,
    ]
    exit_code = cli.main(args)
    payload = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["exit_code"] == exit_code
    return exit_code, payload


def entry_for(report: dict[str, Any], version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    matches = [entry for entry in report["versions"] if entry["version"] == version]
    assert len(matches) == 1, report["versions"]
    return matches[0]


def failed_checks(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [check["check"] for check in entry["failures"]]


def test_generated_v3_archive_passes_every_rule(
    tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    """The single generation path now emits v3; git_commit mode reads the commit,
    so no raw_worktree_hashes claim exists and later worktree drift is ignored."""
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    generate(root, repo, "phase28-t-ok", base, head)
    cli = load_cli_module()

    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase28-t-ok", archive_root=root, repo=repo)
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert exit_code == 0
    entry = entry_for(report, "phase28-t-ok")
    assert entry["archive_class"] == "new" and entry["ok"] is True
    assert entry["failures"] == [] and entry["raw_drift"] == {}
    assert entry["schema_version"] == 3
    check_names = {check["check"] for check in entry["checks"]}
    assert check_names >= {
        "version_matches_directory",

tests/unit/test_phase29_archive.py:
"""Phase29 archive generator tests: schema v3 source binding, temporary git fixtures only.

Zero network, zero Docker, zero model calls. Contract under test
(docs/notes/phase29-archive-schema.md): ``git_commit`` mode reads source text
from ``source_commit`` blobs (never the worktree), requires ``diff_base_commit``
to be an ancestor, and builds ``candidate.diff`` from
``git diff diff_base source_commit``; ``worktree`` mode is the only explicit
dirty-tolerant path and does not claim git provenance. Every candidate carries
``candidate_payload_sha256`` over its own canonical JSON.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from codepilot.archive import (
    ArchiveError,
    DiffVerificationError,
    DirtyWorktreeError,
    MissingSourceError,
    canonical_sha256,
    create_candidate,
)

CODER_SOURCE = '"""Coder fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "coder prompt fixture"\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return _SYSTEM\n'
PLANNER_SOURCE = '"""Planner fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "planner prompt fixture"\n'
REVIEWER_SOURCE = '"""Reviewer fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "reviewer prompt fixture"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n\n\ndef extra() -> str:\n    return 'extra'\n"
NOTE_V1 = "note v1\n"
NOTE_V2 = "note v2 changed\n"
UNLISTED_V1 = "unlisted v1\n"

SOURCE_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
    "src/feature.py",
    "docs/note.md",
)
ARCHIVE_FILES = ("candidate.diff", "candidate.json", "snapshot.json", "sources.json")


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def write_crlf(repo: Path, rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    path = repo / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.replace("\n", "\r\n").encode("utf-8"))


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    """Commit a base tree, then the candidate change; the worktree stays clean."""
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "archive@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Archive Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/coder.py", CODER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE)
    write_crlf(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1)
    write_crlf(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V1)
    write_crlf(repo, "unlisted.txt", UNLISTED_V1)
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    write_crlf(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V2)
    write_crlf(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V2)
    head = commit_all(repo, "candidate change")
    return repo, base, head


def generate(
    root: Path, repo: Path, version: str, base: str, head: str, **kwargs: Any
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version=version,
        parent=kwargs.pop("parent", None),
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=kwargs.pop("source_commit", head),
        source_files=list(SOURCE_PATHS),
        **kwargs,
    )


def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return payload


def normalize(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    return raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").encode("utf-8")


def commit_blob(repo: Path, commit: str, rel: str) -> bytes:
    return git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", f"{commit}:{rel}")


def test_git_commit_mode_reads_sources_from_commit_blobs(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Worktree clean at ``head`` while archiving ``base``: sources must equal the
    base blobs, proving the generator never reads the worktree for content."""
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    summary = generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-commit-src", base, head, source_commit=base)
    folder = Path(summary["directory"])
    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")
    sources = read_json(folder / "sources.json")

    assert candidate["schema_version"] == 3
    assert candidate["source_origin"] == "git_commit"
    assert candidate["source_commit"] == base
    for rel in SOURCE_PATHS:
        blob = commit_blob(repo, base, rel)
        assert sources[rel] == normalize(blob).decode("utf-8")
        assert candidate["source_hashes"][rel] == hashlib.sha256(normalize(blob)).hexdigest()
        assert candidate["base_hashes"][rel] == hashlib.sha256(normalize(blob)).hexdigest()
    assert sources["src/feature.py"] == FEATURE_V1, "worktree content must not leak in"
    assert "raw_worktree_hashes" not in candidate


def test_diff_is_generated_from_commits_not_worktree(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, _head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    # Diverge the worktree further (still clean at head via a new commit) so a
    # worktree-based diff would differ from the commit-vs-commit diff.
    write_crlf(repo, "src/feature.py", "def feature() -> int:\n    return 3\n")
    later = commit_all(repo, "later change")
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    summary = generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-diff-src", base, later)
    folder = Path(summary["directory"])
    expected = git(
        repo,
        "diff",
        "--binary",
        "--no-color",
        "--no-ext-diff",
        "--no-textconv",
        "--no-renames",
        base,
        later,
        "--",
        *SOURCE_PATHS,
    )
    assert (folder / "candidate.diff").read_bytes() == expected
    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")
    assert candidate["source_commit"] == later
    assert (
        candidate["base_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]
        == hashlib.sha256(normalize(commit_blob(repo, base, "src/feature.py"))).hexdigest()
    )
    assert (
        candidate["source_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]
        == hashlib.sha256(normalize(commit_blob(repo, later, "src/feature.py"))).hexdigest()
    )


def test_candidate_payload_sha256_binds_the_whole_record(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)

    declared = candidate.pop("candidate_payload_sha256")
    assert isinstance(declared, str) and len(declared) == 64
    assert declared == canonical_sha256(candidate)
    # Any content change (e.g. flipping status) must invalidate the seal.
    candidate["status"] = "active"
    assert canonical_sha256(candidate) != declared

def test_worktree_mode_records_dirty_tree_without_git_provenance(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, _head = build_repo(tmp_path)

    (repo / "src/feature.py").write_bytes(dirty_text.encode("utf-8"))

        root,

    )
    folder = Path(summary["directory"])
    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")
    sources = read_json(folder / "sources.json")

    assert candidate["schema_version"] == 3
    assert candidate["source_origin"] == "worktree"
    assert candidate["source_commit"] is None
    assert candidate["dirty_worktree"] is True
    assert any("src/feature.py" in line for line in candidate["dirty_files"])
    assert sources["src/feature.py"] == dirty_text, "worktree mode must read the worktree"
    assert (
        candidate["source_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]

    )
    assert (
        candidate["raw_worktree_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]

    assert (
        candidate["base_hashes"]["src/feature.py"]

    )
    # The recorded diff must transform base blobs into the dirty worktree content.
    git(
        repo,
        "apply",
        "--check",
        "-R",
        "--whitespace=nowarn",

tests/unit/test_phase29_archive_security:
"""Phase29 adversarial archive matrix: generator refusals and the tamper grid.

Every case asserts the exact failing check name(s) from
docs/notes/phase29-archive-schema.md §4 — never a bare non-zero exit. Zero
network, zero Docker, zero model calls; throwaway git repositories only.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from codepilot.archive import (
    DirtyWorktreeError,
    NonAncestorDiffBaseError,
    SourceOriginError,
    canonical_sha256,
    create_candidate,
)

CODER_SOURCE = '"""Coder fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "coder prompt fixture"\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return _SYSTEM\n'
PLANNER_SOURCE = '"""Planner fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "planner prompt fixture"\n'
REVIEWER_SOURCE = '"""Reviewer fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "reviewer prompt fixture"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n\n\ndef extra() -> str:\n    return 'extra'\n"
NOTE_V1 = "note v1\n"
NOTE_V2 = "note v2 changed\n"

SOURCE_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
    "src/feature.py",
    "docs/note.md",
)


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def write_file(repo: Path, rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    path = repo / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "sec@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Security Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write_file(repo, "agents/coder.py", CODER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V1)
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V2)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V2)
    head = commit_all(repo, "candidate change")
    return repo, base, head


def generate(root: Path, repo: Path, version: str, base: str, head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version=version,
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(SOURCE_PATHS),
    )


def load_cli_module() -> Any:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "phase28_archive_verify.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase29_security_verify", path)

    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)

def load_manifest_module() -> Any:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "phase29_baseline_manifest.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase29_security_manifest", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def verify(
    cli: Any,
    tmp_path: Path,
    *,
    version: str,
    archive_root: Path,
    repo: Path,
    json_name: str = "report.json",
    extra: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    json_path = tmp_path / json_name
    args = ["--version", version, "--archive-root", str(archive_root), "--repo", str(repo)]
    args += ["--json", str(json_path), *extra]
    exit_code = cli.main(args)
    payload = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["exit_code"] == exit_code
    return exit_code, payload


def entry_for(report: dict[str, Any], version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    matches = [entry for entry in report["versions"] if entry["version"] == version]
    assert len(matches) == 1, report["versions"]
    return matches[0]


def failed_checks(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [check["check"] for check in entry["failures"]]


def write_candidate_json(folder: Path, payload: dict[str, Any], *, reseal: bool) -> None:
    """Write candidate.json; with reseal, recompute the payload seal first."""
    if reseal:
        payload.pop("candidate_payload_sha256", None)
        payload["candidate_payload_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(payload)
    (folder / "candidate.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def load_candidate(folder: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads((folder / "candidate.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def assert_fails_with(
    tmp_path: Path,
    root: Path,
    repo: Path,
    version: str,
    expected: set[str],
    *,
    json_name: str = "report.json",
    extra: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    forbidden: set[str] = frozenset(),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(
        cli,
        tmp_path,
        version=version,
        archive_root=root,
        repo=repo,
        json_name=json_name,
        extra=extra,
    )
    assert exit_code == 1, report
    entry = entry_for(report, version)
    assert entry["ok"] is False
    actual = set(failed_checks(entry))
    assert expected <= actual, f"expected {expected}, got {actual}"
    assert actual.isdisjoint(forbidden), f"unexpected failures {actual & forbidden}"
    return report

    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "archive")
    manifest_mod = load_manifest_module()
    manifest_path = archive_root / "candidates" / "historical-baseline.json"

                "--repo",

                str(manifest_path),
            ]
        )
        == 0
    )
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "freeze")
    # modify + commit: git status stays clean, last-touching commit moves —
    # only the baseline manifest can see this.
    payload = load_candidate(folder)
    payload["status"] = "active"
    write_candidate_json(folder, payload, reseal=True)

    hb = report["historical_baseline"]
    assert hb["ok"] is False

tests/unit/test_phase29_archive_verify.p:
"""Phase29 archive verifier tests: schema v3 source binding and tamper matrix.

Zero network, zero Docker, zero model calls: every test drives a throwaway git
repository and a throwaway archive root under ``tmp_path``. Tamper cases assert
specific check names (docs/notes/phase29-archive-schema.md §4), never a bare
non-zero exit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from codepilot.archive import canonical_sha256, create_candidate

CODER_SOURCE = '"""Coder fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "coder prompt fixture"\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return _SYSTEM\n'
PLANNER_SOURCE = '"""Planner fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "planner prompt fixture"\n'
REVIEWER_SOURCE = '"""Reviewer fixture."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "reviewer prompt fixture"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n\n\ndef extra() -> str:\n    return 'extra'\n"
NOTE_V1 = "note v1\n"
NOTE_V2 = "note v2 changed\n"

SOURCE_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
    "src/feature.py",
    "docs/note.md",
)


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, check=False
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def write_file(repo: Path, rel: str, text: str) -> None:
    path = repo / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "verify@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Verify Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write_file(repo, "agents/coder.py", CODER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE)
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V1)
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    write_file(repo, "src/feature.py", FEATURE_V2)
    write_file(repo, "docs/note.md", NOTE_V2)
    head = commit_all(repo, "candidate change")
    return repo, base, head


def generate(root: Path, repo: Path, version: str, base: str, head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version=version,
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(SOURCE_PATHS),
    )


def load_cli_module() -> Any:
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "phase28_archive_verify.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase29_archive_verify_cli", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def verify(
    cli: Any,
    tmp_path: Path,
    *,
    version: str | None = None,
    archive_root: Path,
    repo: Path,
    json_name: str = "report.json",
    extra: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    json_path = tmp_path / json_name
    args = ["--version", version, "--archive-root", str(archive_root), "--repo", str(repo)]
    if json_path is not None:
        args += ["--json", str(json_path)]
    exit_code = cli.main([*args, *extra])
    payload = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["exit_code"] == exit_code
    return exit_code, payload


def entry_for(report: dict[str, Any], version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    matches = [entry for entry in report["versions"] if entry["version"] == version]
    assert len(matches) == 1, report["versions"]
    return matches[0]


def failed_checks(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [check["check"] for check in entry["failures"]]


def rewrite_candidate(folder: Path, mutate: Any) -> None:
    """Apply ``mutate`` to candidate.json and re-seal candidate_payload_sha256."""
    path = folder / "candidate.json"
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    mutate(payload)
    payload.pop("candidate_payload_sha256", None)
    payload["candidate_payload_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(payload)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def test_generated_v3_archive_passes_every_rule(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-ok", base, head)
    cli = load_cli_module()

    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-ok", archive_root=root, repo=repo)
    assert exit_code == 0
    entry = entry_for(report, "phase29-t-ok")
    assert entry["archive_class"] == "new" and entry["ok"] is True
    check_names = {check["check"] for check in entry["checks"]}
    assert check_names >= {
        "version_matches_directory",
        "snapshot_hash_rule_declared",
        "snapshot_ref_fixed",
        "snapshot_file_sha256",
        "snapshot_canonical_sha256",
        "candidate_payload_sha256",
        "source_origin_declared",
        "origin_dirty_consistency",
        "source_commit_resolves",
        "source_commit_ancestor",
        "source_commit_blob",
        "base_commit_blob",
        "diff_sha256",
        "diff_forward_apply",
        "diff_reverse_apply",
        "source_hashes",
        "source_files_count",
        "not_active",
    }
    assert report["new_archive_status"] == "passed"
    assert not (root / "active.json").exists()


def test_v3_status_tamper_breaks_payload_seal(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    folder = Path(generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-status", base, head)["directory"])
    payload = json.loads((folder / "candidate.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload["status"] = "active"
    (folder / "candidate.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(
        cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-status", archive_root=root, repo=repo
    )
    assert exit_code == 1
    assert failed_checks(entry_for(report, "phase29-t-status")) == ["candidate_payload_sha256"]


def test_v3_source_commit_tamper_breaks_seal_and_blob_binding(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    folder = Path(generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-sc", base, head)["directory"])
    # Variant A: plain field swap without re-sealing -> seal check fires.
    payload = json.loads((folder / "candidate.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload["source_commit"] = base
    (folder / "candidate.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-sc", archive_root=root, repo=repo)
    assert exit_code == 1
    assert "candidate_payload_sha256" in failed_checks(entry_for(report, "phase29-t-sc"))

    # Variant B: swap + re-seal -> the blob binding must catch it instead.
    rewrite_candidate(folder, lambda p: p.update(source_commit=base))
    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-sc", archive_root=root, repo=repo)
    assert exit_code == 1
    failures = failed_checks(entry_for(report, "phase29-t-sc"))
    assert "candidate_payload_sha256" not in failures
    assert "source_commit_blob" in failures


def test_v3_missing_source_origin_fails(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    folder = Path(generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-origin", base, head)["directory"])
    rewrite_candidate(folder, lambda p: p.pop("source_origin"))
    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(
        cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-origin", archive_root=root, repo=repo
    )
    assert exit_code == 1
    assert "source_origin_declared" in failed_checks(entry_for(report, "phase29-t-origin"))


def test_v3_non_ancestor_diff_base_detected(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    folder = Path(generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-anc", base, head)["directory"])
    # diff_base == head is not an ancestor of source_commit == head? It is (equal).
    # Move diff_base forward instead: swap source_commit and diff_base_commit so
    # the claimed base is the descendant.
    rewrite_candidate(
        folder,
        lambda p: p.update(
            diff_base_commit=p["source_commit"], source_commit=p["diff_base_commit"]
        ),
    )
    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-anc", archive_root=root, repo=repo)
    assert exit_code == 1

    assert "source_commit_blob" in failures


def test_v3_source_hashes_drift_breaks_blob_check(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    folder = Path(generate(root, repo, "phase29-t-src", base, head)["directory"])
    # Tamper sources.json consistently with source_hashes (re-sealed): the
    # blob check is the only rule that can still catch it.
    sources_path = folder / "sources.json"
    sources = json.loads(sources_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    sources["src/feature.py"] = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 999\n"
    sources_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(sources, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )

    def mutate(p: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

            sources["src/feature.py"].encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

    cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(cli, tmp_path, version="phase29-t-src", archive_root=root, repo=repo)

    assert "source_commit_blob" in failures

def test_v3_corrupted_diff_breaks_forward_and_reverse_apply(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

def test_historical_baseline_detects_committed_tamper(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A historical candidate file modified AND committed must fail the verifier.

    The manifest check is what catches this: git status stays clean and the
    last-touching commit moves to the tamper commit, so neither heuristic that
    Phase28 relied on can see it.
    """
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    archive_root = repo / "_archive"
    folder = Path(
        create_candidate(
            archive_root,
            repo,
            version="hist-v1",
            diff_base_commit=base,
            source_commit=head,
            source_files=["src/feature.py"],
        )["directory"]
    )
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "archive candidate")
    manifest_mod = load_manifest_module()
    manifest_path = archive_root / "candidates" / "historical-baseline.json"
    assert (
        manifest_mod.main(
            [
                "--archive-root",
                str(archive_root),
                "--repo",
                str(repo),
                "--baseline-commit",
                base,
                "--output",
                str(manifest_path),
            ]
        )
        == 0
    )
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "freeze manifest")

    verify_cli = load_cli_module()
    exit_code, report = verify(
        verify_cli, tmp_path, version="hist-v1", archive_root=archive_root, repo=repo
    )
    assert exit_code == 0
    assert report["historical_baseline"]["ok"] is True

    candidate_path = folder / "candidate.json"
    payload = json.loads(candidate_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload["status"] = "active"
    candidate_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "tamper historical candidate and commit it")

    exit_code, report = verify(
        verify_cli,
        tmp_path,
        version="hist-v1",
        archive_root=archive_root,
        repo=repo,
        json_name="report-tamper.json",
    )
    assert exit_code == 1
    hb = report["historical_baseline"]
    assert hb["ok"] is False
    assert hb["files_checked"] >= 4
    assert any("candidate.json" in rel for rel in hb["mismatches"])
    # The git-status heuristic cannot see a committed tamper; the manifest can.
    assert report["totals"]["historical_files_modified"] is False


def test_manifest_generator_records_baseline_and_refuses_drift(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo, base, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    archive_root = repo / "_archive"
    create_candidate(
        archive_root,
        repo,
        version="hist-v2",
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=["src/feature.py", "docs/note.md"],
    )
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", "candidate")
    mid = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("utf-8").strip()
    manifest_mod = load_manifest_module()

    manifest, drift = manifest_mod.build_manifest(archive_root, repo, baseline_commit=mid)
    assert drift == [] and manifest["zero_change_since_baseline"] is True
    by_path = {entry["path"]: entry for entry in manifest["files"]}
    assert "historical-baseline.json" not in by_path
    assert by_path["candidates/hist-v2/candidate.json"]["baseline_commit_sha256"] is not None

    # Against the pre-candidate baseline the file did not exist -> null blob.
    manifest2, _ = manifest_mod.build_manifest(archive_root, repo, baseline_commit=base)
    by_path2 = {entry["path"]: entry for entry in manifest2["files"]}
    assert by_path2["candidates/hist-v2/candidate.json"]["baseline_commit_sha256"] is None

    # Drifted current bytes: build reports it; main refuses to bless the state.
    candidate_path = archive_root / "candidates" / "hist-v2" / "candidate.json"
    candidate_path.write_bytes(candidate_path.read_bytes() + b" ")
    _, drift3 = manifest_mod.build_manifest(archive_root, repo, baseline_commit=mid)
    assert drift3 and "candidate.json" in drift3[0]
    output = archive_root / "candidates" / "historical-baseline.json"
    assert not output.exists()
    assert (
        manifest_mod.main(
            [
                "--archive-root",
                str(archive_root),
                "--repo",
                str(repo),
                "--baseline-commit",
                mid,
                "--output",
                str(output),
            ]
        )
        == 1
    )
    assert not output.exists()
    assert (
        manifest_mod.main(
            [
                "--archive-root",
                str(archive_root),
                "--repo",
                str(repo),
                "--baseline-commit",
                mid,
                "--output",
                str(output),
                "--allow-drift",
            ]
        )
        == 0
    )
    written = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert written["zero_change_since_baseline"] is False
    assert written["baseline_drift"]
"""Phase30 candidate receipt and external witness tests.

The receipt (configs/harness/receipts/<candidate>.json, outside the candidate
directory) binds the archived bytes to a git commit and pins the historical
manifest bytes. Every negative case here commits its tamper first — "modify
then commit" is the tamper a pure worktree check cannot see — and asserts the
specific failing check. All fixtures are temporary; the real configs/harness is
never touched.
"""

verifier = _load_verifier()


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, check=False)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()


def sha256_bytes(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def write_sources(repo: Path, sources: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    for rel, text in sources.items():
        path = repo / rel

def write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

def write_manifest(archive_root: Path) -> Path:
    """Freeze every file under candidates/ (paths are archive-root relative)."""
    candidates = archive_root / "candidates"
    entries = []
    for path in sorted(candidates.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file() and path.name != "historical-baseline.json":
            entries.append(
                {
                    "path": path.relative_to(archive_root).as_posix(),
                    "sha256": sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes()),
                }
            )
    manifest = {
        "baseline_commit": None,
        "files": entries,
        "note": "phase30 receipt test fixture manifest",
    }
    manifest_path = candidates / "historical-baseline.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest_path


def build_receipt(
    archive_root: Path,
    *,
    version: str,
    candidate_commit: str,
    source_commit: str,
    diff_base: str,
    manifest_path: Path,
) -> Path:
    folder = archive_root / "candidates" / version
    files = {name: sha256_bytes((folder / name).read_bytes()) for name in RECEIPT_FILE_NAMES}
    receipt = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "candidate": version,
        "candidate_commit": candidate_commit,
        "source_commit": source_commit,
        "diff_base": diff_base,
        "candidate_files": files,
        "candidate_tree_sha256": verifier.candidate_tree_sha256(files),
        "historical_manifest_sha256": sha256_bytes(manifest_path.read_bytes()),
        "created_at": "2026-10-31T00:00:00+00:00",
    }
    receipts = archive_root / "receipts"
    receipts.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt_path = receipts / f"{version}.json"
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return receipt_path

def run_verify(
    env: dict[str, Any], *extra: str, tmp_path: Path | None = None
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    json_path = (tmp_path or env["project"]) / "verify-report.json"
    code = verifier.main(
        [
            "--all",
            "--receipt",
            str(env["receipt_path"]),
            *extra,
            "--archive-root",
            str(env["archive_root"]),
            "--repo",
            str(env["project"]),
            "--json",
            str(json_path),
        ]
    )
    report = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return code, report


def receipt_failures(report: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [c["check"] for c in report.get("receipt", {}).get("failures", [])]


def all_failure_names(report: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    names: list[str] = list(receipt_failures(report))
    for version in report.get("versions", []):
        names.extend(c["check"] for c in version.get("failures", []))
    return names

"""Phase30 schema-v4 candidate generation tests (temporary git fixtures only).

Contract under test: v4 records a ``source_manifest`` (``full``/``delta``), a
``full`` source set must cover every ancestor candidate's sources plus the
required role agent files (the v3 defect was archiving only the 26 changed
files), the snapshot inherits prompts/instruction/experiences from the parent
chain instead of archiving an empty policy, generation aborts when the snapshot
cannot be strictly validated (empty role prompts), and commit fields are
resolved full shas rather than worktree labels. The v3 layout stays the default
and byte-compatible.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

)

FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n"
FEATURE_V3 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 3\n"

AGENT_PATHS = (
    "agents/coder.py",
    "agents/planner.py",
    "agents/reviewer.py",
)


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, check=False)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()


def build_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, str, str, str]:
    """Three commits: base -> v2 (parent candidate) -> v3 (child candidate)."""
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "phase30@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Phase30 Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    for rel, text in (
        ("agents/coder.py", CODER_V1),
        ("agents/planner.py", PLANNER_SOURCE),
        ("agents/reviewer.py", REVIEWER_SOURCE),
        ("src/feature.py", FEATURE_V1),
        ("docs/child-note.md", "child note v1\n"),
    ):
        path = repo / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    (repo / "src/feature.py").write_text(FEATURE_V2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    mid = commit_all(repo, "parent change")
    (repo / "src/feature.py").write_text(FEATURE_V3, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    (repo / "agents/coder.py").write_text(CODER_V2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    head = commit_all(repo, "child change")
    return repo, base, mid, head


PARENT_SET = (*AGENT_PATHS, "src/feature.py")


def generate_v3_parent(root: Path, repo: Path, mid: str, head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parent candidate (schema v3 layout) with prompts from its agent sources."""
    return create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version="phase30-parent-v3",
        diff_base_commit=mid,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(PARENT_SET),
    )


def child_source_files(extra: tuple[str, ...] = ("docs/child-note.md",)) -> list[str]:
    return [*PARENT_SET, *extra]


@pytest.fixture()
def v4_env(tmp_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repo, base, mid, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    parent = generate_v3_parent(root, repo, mid, head)
    return {"repo": repo, "root": root, "base": base, "mid": mid, "head": head, "parent": parent}


def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return payload


def test_v4_full_rejects_changed_files_only_subset(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """The v3 defect: archiving only this round's changed files must be refused."""
    with pytest.raises(IncompleteSourceManifestError, match="inherited"):
        create_candidate(
            v4_env["root"],
            v4_env["repo"],
            version="phase30-child-v4",
            parent="phase30-parent-v3",
            diff_base_commit=v4_env["head"],
            source_commit=v4_env["head"],
            source_files=["docs/child-note.md"],
            candidate_schema_version=4,
            manifest_kind="full",
        )
    assert not (v4_env["root"] / "candidates" / "phase30-child-v4").exists()


def test_v4_delta_without_parent_rejected(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

def test_v4_inherits_parent_prompts_and_experiences(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """prompts = parent chain prompts + this round's overrides; all roles non-empty.

    The child commit rewrites agents/coder.py, so coder is overridden from the
    child sources while planner/reviewer stay inherited. Experiences are absent
    this round and the parent has none, so the walk continues to the
    grandparent record when one exists; here the parent itself carries the
    chain's experiences via its own sources.
    """
    env = v4_env
    summary = create_candidate(
        env["root"],
        env["repo"],
        version="phase30-child-v4",
        parent="phase30-parent-v3",
        diff_base_commit=env["mid"],
        source_commit=env["head"],
        source_files=child_source_files(),
        candidate_schema_version=4,
        manifest_kind="full",
    )
    folder = Path(summary["directory"])
    candidate = read_json(folder / "candidate.json")
    snapshot = read_json(folder / "snapshot.json")
    assert candidate["schema_version"] == 4
    assert candidate["candidate_schema_version"] == 4
    assert candidate["status"] == "pending"
    assert candidate["parent"] == "phase30-parent-v3"
    assert candidate["source_manifest"] == {
        "kind": "full",
        "parent": "phase30-parent-v3",
        "required_roles": ["coder", "planner", "reviewer"],
    }
    assert snapshot["prompts"] == {
        "coder": "coder prompt v2 phase30",
        "planner": "planner prompt v1",
        "reviewer": "reviewer prompt v1",
    }
    validate_snapshot(snapshot, env["root"], strict=True)
    # source_files must equal the manifest coverage: parent set + child files.
    assert candidate["source_files"] == len(child_source_files())
    assert set(candidate["source_hashes"]) == set(child_source_files())


def test_v4_strict_empty_prompts_abort_generation(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Agent sources without _SYSTEM literals yield no prompts; v4 must abort."""
    repo, base, _mid, _head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    (repo / "agents/coder.py").write_text(CODER_NO_PROMPT, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    (repo / "agents/planner.py").write_text(CODER_NO_PROMPT, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    (repo / "agents/reviewer.py").write_text(CODER_NO_PROMPT, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    head = commit_all(repo, "strip prompts")
    # Root candidate: no parent chain, so the stripped agent sources are the
    # only prompt source and strict validation must abort generation.
    root_no_inherit = tmp_path / "archive-root"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="strict snapshot"):
        create_candidate(
            root_no_inherit,
            repo,
            version="phase30-noprompt-v4",
            diff_base_commit=base,
            source_commit=head,
            source_files=[*AGENT_PATHS, "src/feature.py"],
            candidate_schema_version=4,
            manifest_kind="full",
        )
    assert not (root_no_inherit / "candidates" / "phase30-noprompt-v4").exists()


def test_v4_dirty_worktree_generates_from_temp_clone(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Dirty tracked worktree + temp clone: sources come from source_commit
    blobs, the user's uncommitted changes are neither stashed nor archived."""
    repo, _base, mid, head = build_repo(tmp_path)
    root = tmp_path / "archive"
    generate_v3_parent(root, repo, mid, head)
    dirty_marker = "UNCOMMITTED USER CHANGE\n"
    (repo / "src/feature.py").write_text(FEATURE_V3 + dirty_marker, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    status = git(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no").decode()
    assert status.strip(), "fixture requires a dirty tracked worktree"
    summary = create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version="phase30-dirty-v4",
        parent="phase30-parent-v3",
        diff_base_commit=mid,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=child_source_files(),
        candidate_schema_version=4,
        manifest_kind="full",
        allow_dirty_via_temp_clone=True,
    )
    assert summary["temp_source_clone"] is True
    candidate = read_json(Path(summary["directory"]) / "candidate.json")
    sources = read_json(Path(summary["directory"]) / "sources.json")
    # Archived text is the commit blob, not the dirty worktree text.
    assert "UNCOMMITTED USER CHANGE" not in sources["src/feature.py"]
    assert sources["src/feature.py"] == FEATURE_V3
    assert candidate["dirty_worktree"] is False
    assert "dirty_files" not in candidate
    # The user's uncommitted change is still in the worktree, untouched.
    assert dirty_marker in (repo / "src/feature.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_v3_default_layout_unchanged(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """The default (no candidate_schema_version) stays the v3 record layout."""
    env = v4_env
    summary = create_candidate(
        env["root"],
        env["repo"],
        version="phase30-v3-legacy",
        parent="phase30-parent-v3",
