    candidate = read_json(Path(summary["directory"]) / "candidate.json")
    assert candidate["schema_version"] == 3
    assert "candidate_schema_version" not in candidate
    assert "source_manifest" not in candidate


def test_v4_resolves_labels_to_full_commit_shas(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """source_commit/diff_base_commit are recorded as resolved full shas, never labels."""
    env = v4_env
    summary = create_candidate(

    )
    candidate = read_json(Path(summary["directory"]) / "candidate.json")
    assert candidate["source_commit"] == env["head"]
    assert candidate["diff_base_commit"] == env["head"]

def test_v4_rejects_unsupported_schema_version(v4_env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ArchiveError, match="candidate_schema_version"):
        create_candidate(
            v4_env["root"],
            v4_env["repo"],
            version="phase30-v9",
            diff_base_commit=v4_env["head"],
            source_commit=v4_env["head"],
            source_files=child_source_files(),
            candidate_schema_version=9,
        )


def test_validate_snapshot_strict_and_empty() -> None:
    """validate_snapshot({}) fails; strict requires all three role prompts."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported policy snapshot"):
        validate_snapshot({})
    base = {"schema_version": 1, "instruction": "", "experiences": []}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="strict snapshot"):
        validate_snapshot({**base, "prompts": {}}, strict=True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="strict snapshot"):
        validate_snapshot(
            {**base, "prompts": {"coder": "x", "planner": "", "reviewer": "y"}}, strict=True
        )
    # Lenient path (schema-1 compatibility) still accepts an empty prompts map.
    lenient = validate_snapshot({**base, "prompts": {}})
    assert lenient["prompts"] == {}
    strict = validate_snapshot(
        {**base, "prompts": {"coder": "c", "planner": "p", "reviewer": "r"}}, strict=True
    )
    assert strict["prompts"]["coder"] == "c"
tests/unit/test_phase30_harness_failclos:
"""Phase30 harness fail-closed activation gate tests.

When an ``active.json`` pointer selects a candidate, the harness must refuse to
run unless that candidate's snapshot carries non-empty prompts for all three
roles — falling back to ``deps.*.system_prompt`` while claiming candidate
provenance is exactly the v3 defect. The no-pointer builtin path keeps working.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import pytest

from codepilot.archive import create_candidate
from codepilot.schemas.state import RepairState

CODER = '"""Coder."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "candidate coder prompt"\n'
PLANNER = '"""Planner."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "candidate planner prompt"\n'
REVIEWER = '"""Reviewer."""\n\n_SYSTEM = "candidate reviewer prompt"\n'
FEATURE_V1 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 1\n"
FEATURE_V2 = "def feature() -> int:\n    return 2\n"


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    completed = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, check=False)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return completed.stdout


def commit_all(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()


def build_candidate_archive(root: Path, repo: Path) -> str:
    """One committed base, one change; v4 root candidate with all three prompts."""
    git(repo, "init")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "phase30@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Phase30 Fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    sources = {
        "agents/coder.py": CODER,
        "agents/planner.py": PLANNER,
        "agents/reviewer.py": REVIEWER,
        "src/feature.py": FEATURE_V1,
    }
    for rel, text in sources.items():
        path = repo / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    base = commit_all(repo, "base")
    (repo / "src/feature.py").write_text(FEATURE_V2, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    head = commit_all(repo, "change")
    create_candidate(
        root,
        repo,
        version="phase30-activatable-v4",
        diff_base_commit=base,
        source_commit=head,
        source_files=list(sources),
        candidate_schema_version=4,
        manifest_kind="full",
    )
    return "phase30-activatable-v4"


def make_deps(run_dir: Path, **overrides: Any) -> Any:
    from codepilot.artifacts import ArtifactStore
    from codepilot.observability.events import EventSink
    from codepilot.observability.lifecycle import Lifecycle
    from codepilot.sandbox.env_spec import EnvSpec

    artifacts = ArtifactStore(run_dir, "run")
    events = EventSink(run_id="run", task_id="task", jsonl_path=artifacts.run_dir / "events.jsonl")
    base = SimpleNamespace(
        artifacts=artifacts,
        lifecycle=Lifecycle(events),
        harness_started=False,
        coder=SimpleNamespace(system_prompt="CODE-DEFAULT-CODER"),
        planner=SimpleNamespace(system_prompt="CODE-DEFAULT-PLANNER"),
        reviewer=SimpleNamespace(system_prompt="CODE-DEFAULT-REVIEWER"),
        repository="repo",
        env_spec=EnvSpec(),
        clock=lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
        experience_snapshot=[],
        tools=SimpleNamespace(query_cache=None),
    )
    for key, value in overrides.items():
        setattr(base, key, value)
    return base


def make_state() -> RepairState:
    return RepairState(
        task_id="task",
        run_id="run",
        repository_id="repo",
        base_commit="abc",
        issue="public issue",
        started_at=datetime.now(UTC),
    )


def write_active_pointer(archive_root: Path, version: str) -> None:
    archive_root.joinpath("active.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"version": version, "new_tasks_only": True}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def archive_env(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> dict[str, Path | str]:
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness

    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    archive_root = tmp_path / "archive"
    version = build_candidate_archive(archive_root, repo)
    monkeypatch.setattr(harness, "archive_root", lambda: archive_root)
    return {
        "archive_root": archive_root,
        "repo": repo,
        "version": version,
        "run_dir": tmp_path / "runs",
    }


def test_builtin_path_without_pointer_is_untouched(
    archive_env: dict[str, Path | str], monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    """No active.json: builtin defaults still run; load_selection is not consulted."""
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness

    def _explode() -> dict[str, Any]:
        raise AssertionError("builtin path must not call load_selection")

    monkeypatch.setattr(harness, "load_selection", _explode)
    deps = make_deps(archive_env["run_dir"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    state = harness.begin(make_state(), deps, "plan")
    assert deps.coder.system_prompt == "CODE-DEFAULT-CODER"
    assert state.policy_snapshot["version"] == "builtin-phase26-v1"


def test_fail_closed_when_selected_candidate_missing_prompts(
    archive_env: dict[str, Path | str],
) -> None:
    """Selected candidate with prompts={} raises instead of using code defaults."""
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness

    archive_root: Path = archive_env["archive_root"]  # type: ignore[assignment]
    version = str(archive_env["version"])
    snapshot_path = archive_root / "candidates" / version / "snapshot.json"
    snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    snapshot["prompts"] = {}
    snapshot_path.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    write_active_pointer(archive_root, version)
    deps = make_deps(archive_env["run_dir"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    with pytest.raises(harness.SnapshotIdentityError) as excinfo:
        harness.begin(make_state(), deps, "plan")
    message = str(excinfo.value)
    assert version in message, "error must name the candidate"
    assert "coder" in message and "planner" in message and "reviewer" in message
    assert str(snapshot_path) in message, "error must name the snapshot path"
    assert deps.coder.system_prompt == "CODE-DEFAULT-CODER", "no code prompt fallback"


def test_fail_closed_when_active_snapshot_unreadable(
    archive_env: dict[str, Path | str],
) -> None:
    """A pointer to a corrupt snapshot must fail closed, not fall back."""
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness

    archive_root: Path = archive_env["archive_root"]  # type: ignore[assignment]
    version = str(archive_env["version"])
    (archive_root / "candidates" / version / "snapshot.json").write_text(
        "{not json", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    write_active_pointer(archive_root, version)
    deps = make_deps(archive_env["run_dir"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    with pytest.raises(harness.SnapshotIdentityError, match="unusable"):
        harness.begin(make_state(), deps, "plan")


def test_fail_closed_when_one_role_prompt_missing(archive_env: dict[str, Path | str]) -> None:
    """Deleting a single role's prompt from the snapshot blocks activation."""
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness

    archive_root: Path = archive_env["archive_root"]  # type: ignore[assignment]
    version = str(archive_env["version"])
    snapshot_path = archive_root / "candidates" / version / "snapshot.json"
    snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    del snapshot["prompts"]["reviewer"]
    snapshot_path.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    write_active_pointer(archive_root, version)
    deps = make_deps(archive_env["run_dir"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    with pytest.raises(harness.SnapshotIdentityError) as excinfo:
        harness.begin(make_state(), deps, "plan")
    assert "reviewer" in str(excinfo.value)


def test_activation_dry_run_uses_candidate_prompts(
    archive_env: dict[str, Path | str],
) -> None:
    """Selecting the v4 candidate: agent prompts come from the snapshot, not code."""
    import codepilot.graph.harness as harness
    from codepilot.rsi import select

    archive_root: Path = archive_env["archive_root"]  # type: ignore[assignment]
    version = str(archive_env["version"])
    select(archive_root, version, allow_pending=True)
    assert archive_root.joinpath("active.json").is_file()
    deps = make_deps(archive_env["run_dir"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    state = harness.begin(make_state(), deps, "plan")
    assert deps.coder.system_prompt == "candidate coder prompt"
    assert deps.planner.system_prompt == "candidate planner prompt"
    assert deps.reviewer.system_prompt == "candidate reviewer prompt"
    assert state.policy_snapshot["version"] == version
    assert state.policy_snapshot["status"] == "pending"

"""Schema 5 completeness, tombstones and strict parent/snapshot regression tests."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from codepilot import archive
from codepilot.archive import (
    ArchiveError,
    IncompleteSourceManifestError,

def commit(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:

def write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:

"""Phase34 T01: the runtime JSON records evidence through a commit, not HEAD.

The Phase33 defect: the JSON was written at C3, but --check recomputed
``base..HEAD`` and compared against it, so the docs/receipt commit C4 became an
extra ``code_commits`` entry and the check could never pass at the final HEAD.
These tests pin the corrected lifecycle on throwaway repositories:

- ``recorded_through``/``head_commit`` come from the written file;
- ``phase_commits`` = ``base..recorded_through``;
- ``code_commits`` is path-filtered (docs/archive commits never count);
- docs-only commits after the evidence keep --check green;
- code commits after the evidence fail with ``code_changed_after_evidence``;
- tampering a recorded commit or hash fails;
- two --write runs are byte-identical and --check never writes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from scripts import phase33_runtime_results as runtime


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    done = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(repo), *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        check=False,
    )
    assert done.returncode == 0, done.stderr
    return done.stdout.strip()


def commit(repo: Path, message: str) -> str:
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-qm", message)
    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


@pytest.fixture
def env(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init", "-q")
    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Phase34 fixture")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
    git(repo, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    write(repo / "src/app.py", "value = 1\n")

"""Phase33 T03: phase32_test_gate.py must isolate pytest basetemp per group run.

D2 旧行为（已删除，非改口径）：``pytest_temp_root()`` 返回全局
``%TEMP%/pytest-of-<user>``，``clear_pytest_temp()`` 在每组运行前删除其**全部**
子项，会误删并发 pytest 进程的数据。新行为：每组每次运行生成独立
``<SCRATCH>/pytest/<suite>-run<n>-<timestamp>`` 并作为 ``--basetemp`` 传给子进程，
运行结束只删除该目录本身。

所有测试都不真跑 pytest：monkeypatch ``subprocess.run`` 捕获命令。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts" / "phase32_test_gate.py"

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase32_test_gate_t03", SCRIPT)
assert _spec is not None and _spec.loader is not None
gate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(gate)

BASETEMP_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<suite>[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)-run(?P<run>\d+)-\d{8}T\d{6}-\d{6}$")


def _install_fake_subprocess(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Monkeypatch gate.subprocess.run; materialise basetemp dirs like real pytest."""
    commands: list[list[str]] = []

    def fake_run(command, **kwargs):  # test double; annotations intentionally loose
        commands.append([str(part) for part in command])
        if command[1:3] == ["-m", "pytest"]:
            for part in command:
                text = str(part)
                if text.startswith("--basetemp="):
                    basetemp = Path(text.split("=", 1)[1])
                    (basetemp / "test_tmp0").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    (basetemp / "test_tmp0" / "junk.bin").write_bytes(b"x" * 2048)
            return SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout="", stderr="")
        return SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout="ripgrep 14.1.0 (fake)\n", stderr="")

    monkeypatch.setattr(gate.subprocess, "run", fake_run)
    return commands


def _pytest_command(commands: list[list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    matches = [cmd for cmd in commands if cmd[1:3] == ["-m", "pytest"]]
    assert len(matches) == 1, f"expected exactly one pytest invocation, got {commands!r}"
    return matches[0]


def _basetemp_of(command: list[str]) -> Path:
    tokens = [part for part in command if part.startswith("--basetemp=")]
    assert len(tokens) == 1, f"pytest command must carry exactly one --basetemp: {command!r}"
    return Path(tokens[0].split("=", 1)[1])


def test_global_temp_helpers_are_deleted_not_reworded() -> None:
    """旧全局根 API 必须彻底消失，且模块不再引用 tempfile。"""
    assert not hasattr(gate, "pytest_temp_root")
    assert not hasattr(gate, "clear_pytest_temp")
    source = SCRIPT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "import tempfile" not in source
    assert "gettempdir" not in source


def test_default_scratch_stays_backward_compatible() -> None:
    assert gate.resolve_scratch(None) == ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase32"
    assert gate.resolve_scratch(".codex-pytest-tmp/phase33") == (
        ROOT / ".codex-pytest-tmp" / "phase33"
    )
    absolute = Path("C:/somewhere/else")
    assert gate.resolve_scratch(str(absolute)) == absolute


def test_run_group_command_has_isolated_basetemp(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    commands = _install_fake_subprocess(monkeypatch)
    scratch = tmp_path / "scratch"
    scratch.mkdir()
    record = gate.run_group("unit", 1, dict(os.environ), "tests/unit/test_x.py", [], scratch)

    command = _pytest_command(commands)
    basetemp = _basetemp_of(command)
    assert basetemp.parent == scratch / "pytest"
    match = BASETEMP_NAME_RE.match(basetemp.name)
    assert match is not None, basetemp.name
    assert match.group("suite") == "unit"
    assert match.group("run") == "1"

    # 组目录在运行结束后被清理，且清理结果记录在 record 里。
    assert not basetemp.exists()
    reclaimed = record["temp_reclaimed"]
    assert reclaimed == {
        "path": str(basetemp),
        "existed": True,
        "removed": True,
        "bytes_removed": 2048,
    }
    assert record["exit_code"] == 0
    assert f"--basetemp={basetemp}" in record["command"]


def test_main_leaves_fake_global_pytest_root_untouched(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    """sentinel：伪造全局 %TEMP%/pytest-of-<user>，跑完 gate 主流程后必须原样存在。"""
    commands = _install_fake_subprocess(monkeypatch)
    fake_temp = tmp_path / "fake-temp"
    sentinel_group = fake_temp / "pytest-of-testuser" / "pytest-42"
    sentinel_group.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sentinel_group / "concurrent-run-data.txt").write_text("do-not-delete", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setenv("TEMP", str(fake_temp))
    monkeypatch.setenv("TMP", str(fake_temp))

    scratch = tmp_path / "gate-scratch"
    summary = scratch / "test-gate.json"
    exit_code = gate.main(
        [
            "--scratch",
            str(scratch),
            "--target",
            "smoke=tests/unit/test_phase33_test_gate.py",
            "--repeat",
            "1",
            "--min-free-mb",
            "0",
            "--min-headroom-mb",
            "0",
        ]
    )

    assert exit_code == 0
    # sentinel 全局根一根手指都没碰
    assert sentinel_group.is_dir()
    assert (sentinel_group / "concurrent-run-data.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == (
        "do-not-delete"
    )
    assert sorted(p.name for p in (fake_temp / "pytest-of-testuser").iterdir()) == ["pytest-42"]
    # 没有任何子进程命令指向伪造全局根
    for command in commands:
        for part in command:
            assert str(fake_temp) not in part

    # gate 自己的组目录被清理，scratch/pytest 下不留残渣
    assert (scratch / "pytest").is_dir()
    assert list((scratch / "pytest").iterdir()) == []

    payload = json.loads(summary.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["failed_runs"] == []
    assert payload["blocked_runs"] == []
    assert payload["scratch"] == str(scratch)
    assert len(payload["runs"]) == 1
    run = payload["runs"][0]
    assert run["suite"] == "smoke"
    assert run["temp_reclaimed"]["removed"] is True
    assert Path(run["basetemp"]).parent == scratch / "pytest"
    assert not Path(run["basetemp"]).exists()
    assert run["log"] == gate.display_path(scratch / "gate-smoke-run1.log")
    assert run["junit"] == gate.display_path(scratch / "gate-smoke-run1.xml")
    assert "summary_line" in run


def test_each_repeat_gets_a_distinct_basetemp_dir(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    commands = _install_fake_subprocess(monkeypatch)
    scratch = tmp_path / "scratch"
    summary = scratch / "test-gate.json"
    exit_code = gate.main(
        [
            "--scratch",
            str(scratch),
            "--target",
            "smoke=tests/unit/test_phase33_test_gate.py",
            "--repeat",
            "2",
            "--min-free-mb",
            "0",
            "--min-headroom-mb",
            "0",
            "--summary",
            str(summary),
        ]
    )
    assert exit_code == 0
    basetemps = [_basetemp_of(cmd) for cmd in commands if cmd[1:3] == ["-m", "pytest"]]
    assert len(basetemps) == 2
    assert basetemps[0] != basetemps[1]
    assert {b.parent for b in basetemps} == {scratch / "pytest"}
    assert all(not b.exists() for b in basetemps)
    assert list((scratch / "pytest").iterdir()) == []

"""Phase34 T02/P1: normalization policy must match what the archive stores.

git_commit candidates store LF hashes only; worktree candidates store raw hashes
too. New candidates carry a structured ``normalization_policy`` selected by
source_origin. Historical v3/v4/v5/v6 candidates predate the policy and are
exempt only when BOTH the version and the sealed payload hash match the pinned
table, so a new candidate cannot bypass the requirement by reusing an old note.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

    GIT_NORMALIZATION_POLICY,

    NORMALIZATION_NOTE_WORKTREE,
    WORKTREE_NORMALIZATION_POLICY,
    SourceOriginError,
    canonical_sha256,
    create_candidate,
)


def reseal(record: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    record.pop("candidate_payload_sha256", None)
    record["candidate_payload_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(record)


def verify(env: dict) -> dict:
    folder = env["root"] / "candidates" / CHILD
    return verify_new_archive(
        folder,
        read(folder / "candidate.json"),
        archive_root=env["root"],

        "base": base,
        "code": code,
        "tip": tip,
        "scratch": tmp_path / "scratch",
        "out": tmp_path / "runtime.json",
    }


def run(env: dict[str, Any], mode: str, *extra: str) -> int:
    return runtime.main([mode, "--scratch", str(env["scratch"]), "--out", str(env["out"]), *extra])


def written(env: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads(env["out"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_write_records_lifecycle(env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    payload = written(env)
    assert payload["recorded_through"] == env["tip"]
    assert payload["recorded_head"] == env["tip"]
    assert payload["actual_head_at_write"] == env["tip"]
    assert {item["hash"] for item in payload["phase_commits"]} == {env["code"], env["tip"]}
    assert [item["hash"] for item in payload["code_commits"]] == [env["code"]]


def test_check_passes_at_recorded_through(env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    assert run(env, "--check") == 0


def test_docs_only_commit_after_evidence_keeps_check_green(env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    write(env["repo"] / "docs/notes/after.md", "later docs\n")
    commit(env["repo"], "docs after evidence")
    assert run(env, "--check") == 0


def test_code_commit_after_evidence_fails(
    env: dict[str, Any], capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    write(env["repo"] / "src/app.py", "value = 3\n")
    commit(env["repo"], "code after evidence")
    assert run(env, "--check") == 1
    assert "code_changed_after_evidence" in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_tampered_recorded_head_fails(
    env: dict[str, Any], capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    payload = written(env)
    payload["recorded_head"] = env["base"]
    env["out"].write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert run(env, "--check") == 1
    assert "recorded_head_mismatch" in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_double_write_is_byte_identical(env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    first = env["out"].read_bytes()
    assert run(env, "--write") == 0
    assert env["out"].read_bytes() == first


def test_check_does_not_modify_json(env: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert run(env, "--write", "--base", env["base"]) == 0
    before = env["out"].read_bytes()
    assert run(env, "--check") == 0
    assert env["out"].read_bytes() == before
